    RECOVERABLE_MODEL_FAILURES = frozenset({"serverOverloaded", "internalServerError"})
    logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    
    
    def recoverable_model_failure(root: Path) -> str | None:
        """Return a machine-classified transient failure, never infer it from prose."""
        path = path_for(root)
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        state = read_record(path, "state", "run") or {}
        flight = state.get("inFlight") or {}
        model = flight.get("modelStatus") or {}
        reason = model.get("reason")
        if (
            state.get("status") == "paused"
            and flight.get("agentPhase") == "FAILED"
            and model.get("state") == "failed"
            and reason in RECOVERABLE_MODEL_FAILURES
        ):
            return reason
        return None
    
    
    def ensure_auth(root, image):
        private_directory(root)
        private_directory(root / "ipc")
        if not (root / "codex/auth.json").is_file():
            raise ContainerError("Run civ-agent auth login before launching games")
        with locked(root / ".launch.lock", wait=True):
            name = auth_name(root)
            current = inspected(name)
            if not current or not current["State"]["Running"]:
                if current:
                    podman("rm", name)
                (root / "ready.json").unlink(missing_ok=True)
                arguments = base_arguments(name, game_id="auth", resources=ContainerResources(memory_mib=512, cpus=0.5))
                podman(
                    *arguments,
                    "--network=pasta:-4",
                    *mount(root, "/auth", writable=True),
                    "--env",
                    "HOME=/auth",
                    "--env",
                    "CODEX_HOME=/auth/codex",
                    image,
                    "auth",
                )
                podman("start", name)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
            while not (root / "ready.json").exists():
                current = inspected(name)
                if not current or not current["State"]["Running"] or time.monotonic() > deadline:
                    raise ContainerError("Benchmark login manager failed; run civ-agent auth status")
                time.sleep(0.2)
        return name
    
    
    def agent_auth_arguments(auth_root, name, provider):
        """Only the selected credential is mounted; keys never appear in Podman argv/env."""
        if provider == "openrouter":
            return [
                *mount(auth_root / "openrouter.key", "/run/secrets/openrouter.key"),
                "--env",
                "CIV_OPENROUTER_KEY_FILE=/run/secrets/openrouter.key",
            ]
        return [
            *mount(auth_root / "ipc", "/auth-ipc"),
            "--env",
            "CIV_AUTH_SOCKET=/auth-ipc/broker.sock",
            "--env",
            f"CIV_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE=/match/agent-services/{name}/auth-client.json",
        ]
    
    
    def validate_routing_credentials(config, auth_root):
        if config.agents.diplomacy_routing_enabled:
            key = auth_root / "decisions.key"
            if not key.is_file():
                raise ContainerError(
                    "Diplomacy routing requires a separate OpenAI API key in AUTH_DIR/decisions.key (mode 600)"
                )
            from civ_agent.decisions_broker import read_decisions_key
    
            read_decisions_key(key)
    
    
    def ensure_decisions(root, image):
        private_directory(root / "decisions-ipc")
        with locked(root / ".decisions-launch.lock", wait=True):
            name = auth_name(root) + "-decisions"
            current = inspected(name)
            if current and current["State"]["Running"] and current.get("Image") != image:
                raise ContainerError(
                    "The shared Decisions broker uses a different runtime image. "
                    "Stop its affected games before replacing that broker, or select a separate auth directory."
                )
            if not current or not current["State"]["Running"]:
                if current:
                    podman("rm", name)
                (root / "decisions-ready.json").unlink(missing_ok=True)
                arguments = base_arguments(name, game_id="auth", resources=ContainerResources(memory_mib=512, cpus=0.5))
                podman(*arguments, "--network=pasta:-4", *mount(root, "/auth", writable=True), image, "decisions")
                podman("start", name)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
            while not (root / "decisions-ready.json").exists():
                current = inspected(name)
                if not current or not current["State"]["Running"] or time.monotonic() > deadline:
                    raise ContainerError("Decisions broker failed to start")
                time.sleep(0.2)
            # The ready file is not evidence that the player socket is reachable or
            # speaks this protocol. Authenticate with a trusted operator credential.
            authorize_agent(root, "operator", "health", root / "operator", decisions=True)
            health = routing_broker_health(root, timeout=5)
            if health["status"] != "ready":
                raise ContainerError(f"Decisions broker preflight failed: {health.get('reason', health['status'])}")
            report = {**health, "checkedAtMs": int(time.time() * 1000), "image": image}
            write_private_json(root / "decisions-preflight.json", report)
            return report
    
    
    def routing_broker_health(root, *, timeout=1):
        """Inspect the existing broker without starting it or calling the provider."""
        from civ_agent.decisions_broker import RoutingClient
    
        return asyncio.run(
            RoutingClient(root / "decisions-ipc/broker.sock", root / "operator/decisions-client.json").health(
                timeout=timeout
            )
        )
    
    
    def decisions_arguments(auth_root, name):
        return [
            *mount(auth_root / "decisions-ipc", "/decisions-ipc"),
            "--env",
            "CIV_DECISIONS_SOCKET=/decisions-ipc/broker.sock",
            "--env",
            f"CIV_DECISIONS_TOKEN_FILE=/match/agent-services/{name}/decisions-client.json",
        ]
    
    
    def authorize_agent(auth_root, game_id, seat, directory, *, decisions=False):
        path = directory / ("decisions-client.json" if decisions else "auth-client.json")
        if not path.exists():
            write_private_json(path, {"token": secrets.token_urlsafe(32)})
        token = read_json(path)["token"]
        with locked(auth_root / ".clients.lock", wait=True):
            registry = auth_root / ("decisions-clients.json" if decisions else "clients.json")
            clients = read_json(registry, {})
            clients[f"{game_id}-{seat}"] = hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest()
            write_private_json(registry, clients)
    
    
    def validate_setup(config, image):
        # Validate with the same packaged engine used for gameplay, without model credentials.
        result = podman(
            "run",
            "--rm",
            "--network=none",
            "--userns=keep-id",
            "--cap-drop=ALL",
            "--security-opt=no-new-privileges",
            "--read-only",
            "--tmpfs",
            "/tmp:rw,size=512m,mode=1777",
            "--memory=4g",
            "--pids-limit=512",
            image,
            "validate",
            *config.engine_arguments(),
            timeout=300,
        )
        lines = [
            line.removeprefix("SETUP-READY:") for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("SETUP-READY:")
        ]
        if len(lines) != 1:
            raise ContainerError("Native setup validation did not return a result")
        return json.loads(lines[0])
    
    
    class GameRun:
        def __init__(self, root, stop_event=None):

        def status(self, status, **extra):
            write_private_json(
                self.root / "container-status.json",
                {
                    "id": self.game_id,
                    "status": status,
                    "updated_at": time.time(),
                    **extra,
                },
            )
    
        def start(self, arguments, name, image, *entry):
            podman(*arguments, image, *entry)
            self.names.append(name)
            podman("start", name)
            path = self.launch_dir / (name + ".log")
            log = path.open("a")
            self.log_files.append(log)

        def await_ready(self, predicate):
            deadline = time.monotonic() + self.config.limits.startup_timeout
            while not predicate():
                if self.stop_event.is_set():
                    raise InterruptedError("Operator requested stop")
                self.check_services()
                if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                    raise ContainerError("Container startup timed out; inspect launch logs")
                time.sleep(0.2)
    
        def check_services(self):
            if not self.names:
                return []
            records = json.loads(podman("container", "inspect", *self.names).stdout)
            for record in records:
                if not record["State"]["Running"]:
                    self.native_failure = {"container": record["Name"], "state": record["State"]}
                    raise ContainerError(
                        f"{record['Name']} exited: {record['State'].get('ExitCode')}; "
                        f"OOM killed: {record['State'].get('OOMKilled', False)}"
                    )
            return records

        def stop(self):
            if self.controller in self.names:
                write_private_json(self.root / "control/request.json", {"action": "stop"})
                # Scheduler first: it cancels/quiesces model work and flushes accounting.
                podman("stop", "--time", "90", self.controller, timeout=100, check=False)
            stop_containers([name for name in self.names if name != self.controller])
            for process in self.log_processes:
                with contextlib.suppress(subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                    process.wait(timeout=3)
                if process.poll() is None:
                    process.terminate()
                    process.wait()
            for log in self.log_files:
                log.close()
    
        def run_once(self):
            status, error = "failed", None
            self.names, self.log_processes, self.log_files, self.log_paths = [], [], [], {}
            self.native_failure = None
            self.status("starting")
            try:
                self.setup()
                self.status("running", browser=read_json(self.root / "browser.json"))
                sampled = 0.0
                while not self.stop_event.wait(1):
                    runtime = read_json(self.root / "runtime.json", {})
                    if runtime.get("phase") == "stopped":
                        status = {
                            "complete": "completed",
                            "budget_exhausted": "budget_exhausted",
                            "paused": "paused",
                            "stopped": "paused",
                        }.get(runtime.get("runner_status"), "failed")
                        error = runtime.get("reason")
                        break
                    self.check_services()
                    if time.monotonic() - sampled > 10:
                        result = podman("stats", "--no-stream", "--format", "json", *self.names, check=False)
                        if result.returncode == 0:
                            sample = {
                                "at": time.time(),
                                "launch": self.record["launch"],
                                "containers": json.loads(result.stdout),
                            }
                            with (self.root / "resources.jsonl").open("a") as stream:
                                stream.write(json.dumps(sample) + "\n")
                            write_private_json(self.root / "resources.json", sample)
                        sampled = time.monotonic()
                else:
                    status = "paused"
            except InterruptedError:
                status = "paused"
            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as failure:
                error = str(failure)
            finally:
                try:
                    self.stop()
                except (OSError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as failure:
                    status, error = "failed", f"{error or ''} Cleanup failed: {failure}".strip()
                self.status(
                    status, reason=error, failure=self.native_failure, browser=read_json(self.root / "browser.json")
                )
            return status
    
        def run(self):
            with locked(self.root / ".supervisor.lock"):
                retries = 0
                while True:
                    status = self.run_once()
                    reason = recoverable_model_failure(self.root) if status == "paused" else None
                    if reason is None:
                        return status
                    if retries >= self.config.limits.model_capacity_retries:
                        self.status(
                            "paused",
                            reason=f"Model capacity remained unavailable after {retries} automatic retries.",
                            recovery={"reason": reason, "attempts": retries, "exhausted": True},
                        )
                        return status
                    retries += 1
                    delay = self.config.limits.model_capacity_retry_delay
                    self.status(
                        "retrying",
                        reason=f"Model capacity is unavailable; retrying in {delay} seconds.",
                        recovery={
                            "reason": reason,
                            "attempt": retries,
                            "maximum": self.config.limits.model_capacity_retries,
                        },
                    )
                    if self.stop_event.wait(delay):
                        self.status("paused", reason="Operator stopped automatic model-capacity recovery.")
                        return "paused"
    
    
    BATCH_SUMMARY_INTERVAL = 10.0
    
    
    def _previous_batch_results(root):
        """Best-effort fallback from derived output, including summaries predating freshness fields."""
        try:
            summary = read_json(root / "results.json", {})
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return {}
        if not isinstance(summary, dict) or not isinstance(summary.get("runs", []), list):
            return {}
        return {
            row["id"]: {"result_updated_at": summary.get("updated_at"), **row}
            for row in summary.get("runs", [])
            if isinstance(row, dict) and isinstance(row.get("id"), str)
        }
    
    
    def batch_summary(root, manifest):
        rows = []
        previous = None
        for run in manifest["runs"]:
            directory = root / "games" / run["id"]
            saved = read_json(directory / "resolved.json")
            if saved is None:
                raise ContainerError(f"Saved configuration is missing for game {run['id']}")
            config = ResolvedGameConfig.model_validate(saved)
            path = path_for(directory)
            result_stale = False
            try:
                available = path.exists()
                result = read_record(path, "state", "result") if available else None
                result_updated_at = time.time() if available else None
            except OperationalError as error:
                # SQLite's extended codes retain the primary code in the low byte.
                # Only transient read contention is optional; do not hide other database failures.
                if getattr(error.orig, "sqlite_errorcode", 0) & 0xFF not in {sqlite3.SQLITE_BUSY, sqlite3.SQLITE_LOCKED}:
                    raise
                if previous is None:
                    previous = _previous_batch_results(root)
                cached = previous.get(run["id"], {})
                result = cached.get("result")
                result_updated_at = cached.get("result_updated_at")
                result_stale = True
                if not cached.get("result_stale"):
                    logger.warning(
                        "Game %s monitoring database is busy: %s. Retaining the last result; "
                        "retrying at the next summary refresh. Gameplay continues.",
                        run["id"],
                        path,
                    )
            rows.append(
                {
                    **{k: v for k, v in run.items() if k != "config"},
                    "master_seed": config.game.master_seed,
                    "map_seed": config.game.map_seed,
                    "starting_position_seed": config.game.starting_position_seed,
                    "assignment_seed": config.game.assignment_seed,
                    "players": config.player_records(),
                    "result": result,
                    "result_stale": result_stale,
                    "result_updated_at": result_updated_at,
                    "resources": config.resources.model_dump(),
                    "resource_usage": read_json(directory / "resources.json"),
                    "failure": read_json(directory / "container-status.json", {}).get("reason"),
                }
            )
        write_private_json(
            root / "results.json", {"parallel": manifest["parallel"], "updated_at": time.time(), "runs": rows}
        )
        with (root / "results.csv").open("w", newline="") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(
                stream,
                fieldnames=(
                    "id",
                    "master_seed",
                    "map_seed",
                    "starting_position_seed",
                    "assignment_seed",
                    "status",
                    "players",
                    "result",
                    "result_stale",
                    "result_updated_at",
                    "failure",
                ),
            )
            writer.writeheader()
            for row in rows:
                writer.writerow(
                    {
                        key: json.dumps(row[key]) if isinstance(row.get(key), (dict, list)) else row.get(key)
                        for key in writer.fieldnames
                    }
                )
    
    
    def run_batch(root, stop_event):
        with locked(root / ".supervisor.lock"):
            manifest = read_json(root / "batch.json")
            if not isinstance(manifest, dict) or manifest.get("format") != 2:
                raise ContainerError("Unsupported batch manifest; start a new batch")
            active = {}
            last_summary = 0.0
            with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=manifest["parallel"]) as pool:
                try:
                    batch_summary(root, manifest)
                    last_summary = time.monotonic()
                    while True:
                        for future, run in list(active.items()):
                            if future.done():
                                try:
                                    run["status"] = future.result()
                                except Exception as failure:
                                    run["status"], run["error"] = "failed", str(failure)
                                del active[future]
                                write_private_json(root / "batch.json", manifest)
                                batch_summary(root, manifest)
                                last_summary = time.monotonic()
                        queued = [r for r in manifest["runs"] if r["status"] == "pending"]
                        started = False
                        if not stop_event.is_set():
                            for run in queued[: manifest["parallel"] - len(active)]:
                                run["status"] = "running"
                                write_private_json(root / "batch.json", manifest)
                                active[pool.submit(GameRun(root / "games" / run["id"], stop_event).run)] = run
                                started = True
                        if started or time.monotonic() - last_summary >= BATCH_SUMMARY_INTERVAL:
                            batch_summary(root, manifest)
                            last_summary = time.monotonic()
                        if not active and (stop_event.is_set() or not queued):
                            break
                        time.sleep(0.5)
                finally:
                    stop_event.set()
            batch_summary(root, manifest)
    
    
    def main():
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("role", choices=("game", "batch"))
        parser.add_argument("--state-dir", required=True, type=Path)
        args = parser.parse_args()
        os.umask(0o077)
        stop_event = threading.Event()
        for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
            signal.signal(sig, lambda *_: stop_event.set())
        if args.role == "game":
            GameRun(args.state_dir, stop_event).run()
        else:
            run_batch(args.state_dir, stop_event)
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def server(app, *, socket=None):
        runner = web.AppRunner(app)
        await runner.setup()
        site = web.UnixSite(runner, str(socket)) if socket else web.TCPSite(runner, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        await site.start()
        try:
            yield "http://localhost" if socket else "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(runner.addresses[0][1])

            await runner.cleanup()
            if socket:

    def test_client_request_no_retry_and_temporary_circuit():
        async def run():
            calls, clock = [], [0.0]
    
            async def classify(request):
                calls.append((request.headers.get("Authorization"), await request.json()))
                if len(calls) <= 3:
                    raise web.HTTPServiceUnavailable()
                return web.json_response(
                    {
                        "answers": [{"name": "delivery", "type": "choice", "choice": "batch", "confidence": 0.99}],
                        "usage": {"input_tokens": 15, "output_tokens": 1},
                    }
                )
    
            app = web.Application()
            app.router.add_post("/v1/decisions", classify)
            async with server(app) as url:
                client = DecisionsClient("separate-test-key", endpoint=url + "/v1/decisions", clock=lambda: clock[0])
                for _ in range(3):
                    assert (await client.classify("outgoing", {}))["fallback"] == "service_failure"
                assert len(calls) == 3  # one HTTP request per classification, never automatic retries
                assert (await client.classify("outgoing", {}))["fallback"] == "circuit_open"
                assert len(calls) == 3
                clock[0] = 31
                result = await client.classify("outgoing", {"text": "a claim"})
                assert result["choice"] == "batch" and result["usage"]["input_tokens"] == 15
                assert calls[-1][0] == "Bearer separate-test-key"
                assert calls[-1][1]["model"] == "gpt-6-luna"
                assert isinstance(calls[-1][1]["input"], str)
    
        asyncio.run(run())

                body = {"direction": "outgoing", "bundle": {"text": "private claim"}}
                for token in (None, "Bearer ", "Bearer provider-token", "routing-token"):
                    async with session.post(
                        url + "/classify", json=body, headers={} if token is None else {"Authorization": token}
                    ) as response:
                        assert response.status == 401
                headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer routing-token"}
                for invalid in ({**body, "api_key": "injection"}, {**body, "direction": []}, {**body, "bundle": []}):
                    async with session.post(url + "/classify", json=invalid, headers=headers) as response:

    """Transactional private memory. Markdown is an export, never an input authority.
    
    All methods are short synchronous transactions, called on ServiceIO's worker.
    Model computation and HTTPS requests happen outside these transactions.
    """
    
    import hashlib

    # Native offers belong to gameplay even when another message starts a conversation.
    COMMUNICATION_EVENTS = or_(
        tables.events.c.kind != "trade",
        func.json_extract(tables.events.c.body, "$.body.mode").is_distinct_from("NATIVE_AI"),
    )
    
    
    class StateConflict(ValueError):
        pass
    
    
    class MemoryFormatError(StateConflict):
        """An unsupported store needs a fresh match, not an implicit migration."""
    
    
    class CivilizationState:
        def __init__(self, root: Path, civilization: str, context_limit: int = 12000):
            self.root = private_directory(root)
            self.path = self.root / "memory.sqlite3"
            self.civilization = civilization
            self.routing_enabled = False
            if context_limit < 1000:
                raise ValueError("Private memory context limit must be at least 1000 characters")
            self.context_limit = context_limit
            if self.path.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("Unsafe memory path")
            self.engine = sqlite_engine(self.path)
            with self.transaction() as db:
                exists = inspect(db).has_table("meta")
                if exists and self._meta(db, "format") != tables.FORMAT_VERSION:
                    raise MemoryFormatError("Unsupported memory format; start a fresh match in a new state directory.")
                tables.metadata.create_all(db)
                existing = self._meta(db, "civilization")
                if existing is not None and existing != civilization:
                    raise StateConflict("CIVILIZATION_CONFLICT")
                self._set(db, "civilization", civilization)
                self._set(db, "format", tables.FORMAT_VERSION)
                if self._meta(db, "storeId") is None:
                    self._set(db, "storeId", secrets.token_hex(16))
                # A process restart never resumes a model's uncommitted computation.
                db.execute(tables.jobs.update().where(tables.jobs.c.status == "RUNNING").values(status="INTERRUPTED"))
            self.path.chmod(0o600)
    
        @contextmanager
        def transaction(self):
            with self.engine.begin() as db:
                yield db
    
        @staticmethod
        def _meta(db, key, default=None) -> Any:
            row = db.execute(select(tables.meta.c.value).where(tables.meta.c.key == key)).fetchone()
            return json.loads(row[0]) if row else default
    
        @staticmethod
        def _set(db, key, value):
            db.execute(insert(tables.meta).values(key=key, value=encode(value)).prefix_with("OR REPLACE"))
    
        def bind(self, epoch: str):
            with self.transaction() as db:
                if self._meta(db, "epoch", epoch) != epoch:
                    raise StateConflict("STALE_EPOCH")
                self._set(db, "epoch", epoch)
    
        def cursor(self) -> int:
            with self.transaction() as db:
                return self._meta(db, "cursor", 0)
    
        def ingest(self, epoch: str, events: list[JsonObject], cursor: int):
            """Commit authenticated events and their reconnect cursor together."""
            with self.transaction() as db:
                if self._meta(db, "paused", False):
                    raise StateConflict("STATE_PAUSED")
                if self._meta(db, "epoch") != epoch:
                    raise StateConflict("STALE_EPOCH")
                for event in events:
                    source = epoch + ":" + str(event["id"])
                    db.execute(
                        insert(tables.events)
                        .values(source=source, kind=event["kind"], body=encode(event), wake=bool(event.get("wake")))
                        .prefix_with("OR IGNORE")
                    )
                    inserted = db.execute(
                        insert(tables.inbox)
                        .from_select(["id"], select(tables.events.c.id).where(tables.events.c.source == source))

                        # The first durable event body remains the source of truth.
                        continue
                    if self.routing_enabled:
                        event_id = db.execute(
                            select(tables.events.c.id).where(tables.events.c.source == source)
                        ).scalar_one()

                        routes[str(event_id)] = {"receivedAt": time.time()}
                        self._set(db, "routing:events", routes)

                    # world observation inferred from that utterance's content.

                        db,
                        "event:" + str(event["id"]),
                        "observation" if event["kind"] in {"engine", "agreement", "diplomacy"} else "statement",

                    )

                        body = event.get("body", {})
                        participants = body.get("participants", [])
                        subjects = set(participants)
                        if event["kind"] == "diplomacy":
                            subjects.update(
                                value for key in ("author", "target") if isinstance(value := body.get(key), str)
                            )
                        if event["kind"] == "engine":
                            for war in body.get("wars", []):
                                subjects.update((war["declaringCivilization"], war["targetCivilization"]))
                        label = next(
                            (
                                body[field]
                                for field in ("action", "kind", "event", "decision", "status")
                                if isinstance(body.get(field), str)
                            ),
                            event["kind"],
                        )
                        if body.get("status") and label != body["status"]:
                            label += " (" + body["status"] + ")"
                        RecordStore(db, self._meta(db, "gameTurn")).flag(
                            subjects=sorted(subjects),
                            reason=label + ": " + ", ".join(sorted(subjects)),
                            review_keys=["event:" + str(event["id"])],
                        )
                    elif event["kind"] == "agreement":
                        body = event.get("body", {})
                        store = RecordStore(db, self._meta(db, "gameTurn"))
                        keys = []
                        if isinstance(body.get("agreement"), str):
                            listing = store.all().get("observation:agreements")
                            if listing is not None:
                                versions = {
                                    row["agreement"]: row.get("version", 0) for row in listing["body"].get("agreements", [])
                                }
                                required = listing["body"].get("latestVersions", {})
                                latest = max(versions.get(body["agreement"], 0), required.get(body["agreement"], 0))
                                if body.get("version", 0) > latest:
                                    keys.append("observation:agreements")
                                    store.write(
                                        "observation:agreements",
                                        "observation",
                                        {
                                            **listing["body"],
                                            "requiresRefresh": True,
                                            "latestVersions": {**required, body["agreement"]: body["version"]},
                                        },
                                    )
                            key = "observation:agreement/" + body["agreement"]
                            keys.append(key)
                            prior = store.all().get(key)

        @staticmethod
        def _record(db, key, category, body, job=None):
            return RecordStore(db).write(key, category, body, job)
    
        def _advance_turn(self, db, turn):
            if type(turn) is int and turn >= 0:
                self._set(db, "gameTurn", max(turn, self._meta(db, "gameTurn", 0)))
    
        def observe(self, key: str, body: JsonObject, job: str | None = None):
            with self.transaction() as db:
                return self._observe(db, key, body, job)
    def select_context(snapshot, limit):
        turn = snapshot.get("gameTurn")
        subjects = set(snapshot.get("contextTopics", []))
        for event in snapshot["events"]:
            body = event.get("body", {})
            event_turn = event.get("turn", body.get("turn"))
            if type(turn) is int and type(event_turn) is int and event_turn < turn - 1:
                continue
            subjects.update(body.get("participants", []))
            subjects.update(
                v for v in (body.get("author"), body.get("from"), body.get("to"), body.get("partner")) if isinstance(v, str)
            )
        subjects = {subject.casefold() for subject in subjects}
    
        def relevant(record):
            return any(subject.casefold() in subjects for subject in record["body"].get("subjects", []))
    
        candidates = [
            (key, value)
            for key, value in snapshot["records"].items()
            if value["category"] in MEMORY_TYPES | {"contribution"}
            and value["body"].get("state") == "active"
            and not expired_at(value, snapshot.get("gameTurn"))
            and (value["category"] != "handoff" or snapshot["purpose"] == "gameplay" and handoff_eligible(value, turn))
        ]
        available = len(candidates)
        # A spare character budget is not a reason to repeat old notes. Strategies,
        # next-turn handoffs and unhandled contributions have explicit lifecycles;
        # historical knowledge needs recency, a current subject, or a review notice.
        candidates = [
            (key, record)
            for key, record in candidates
            if record["category"] in {"strategy", "handoff", "contribution"}
            or record["body"].get("needsReview")
            or relevant(record)
            or type(turn) is not int
            or (record["body"].get("updatedTurn") or 0) >= turn - 2
        ]
        candidates.sort(
            key=lambda item: (
                {"strategy": 0, "handoff": 1}.get(item[1]["category"], 2),
                not relevant(item[1]),
                not bool(item[1]["body"].get("needsReview")),
                -item[1]["body"].get("priority", 3),
                -(item[1]["body"].get("updatedTurn") or 0),
                item[0],
            )
        )
        chosen, used = {}, 2  # JSON array brackets, then commas between chosen records.
        for key, record in candidates:
            size = len(encode(public_record(key, record))) + bool(chosen)
            if used + size <= limit:
                chosen[key] = record
                used += size
        return chosen, available - len(chosen)

    import json
    
    from sqlalchemy import insert, select
    
    from civ_agent import memory_schema as tables
    from civ_agent.memory_store import encode
    from civ_agent.review_context import review_position
    
    
    class ReviewStore:
        def __init__(self, memory):
            self.memory = memory
    
        def pending(self):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                row = db.execute(select(tables.reviews).where(tables.reviews.c.status == "PENDING")).mappings().first()
                return dict(row) if row else None
    
        def last_position(self):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                return self.memory._meta(db, "reviewPosition")
    
        def at_turn(self, turn):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                row = (
                    db.execute(
                        select(
                            tables.reviews.c.job, tables.reviews.c.turn, tables.reviews.c.status, tables.reviews.c.attempts
                        ).where(tables.reviews.c.turn == turn)
                    )
                    .mappings()
                    .first()
                )
                return dict(row) if row else None
    
        def last_completed_turn(self):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                return db.execute(
                    select(tables.reviews.c.turn)
                    .where(tables.reviews.c.status == "COMPLETED")
                    .order_by(tables.reviews.c.turn.desc())
                    .limit(1)
                ).scalar()
    
        def prepare(self, id, inputs, settings, timeout):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                if (
                    db.execute(select(tables.reviews.c.job).where(tables.reviews.c.turn == inputs["turn"])).first()
                    is not None
                ):
                    return
                db.execute(
                    insert(tables.reviews).values(
                        job=id,
                        turn=inputs["turn"],
                        status="PENDING",
                        attempts=0,
                        inputs=encode(inputs),
                        settings=encode(settings),
                        timeout=timeout,
                    )
                )
    
        def blocking(self, epoch, turn):
            """Only read readiness metadata; frozen inputs may be large."""
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                if self.memory._meta(db, "epoch", epoch) != epoch:
                    raise ValueError("WORKSPACE_EPOCH_CONFLICT")
                row = (
                    db.execute(
                        select(
                            tables.reviews.c.job, tables.reviews.c.turn, tables.reviews.c.status, tables.reviews.c.attempts
                        )
                        .where(available_for_turn(turn), tables.reviews.c.status != "COMPLETED")
                        .order_by(tables.reviews.c.turn)
                        .limit(1)
                    )
                    .mappings()
                    .first()
                )
                return dict(row) if row else None
    
        def attempt(self, parent, limit):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                row = db.execute(select(tables.reviews).where(tables.reviews.c.job == parent)).mappings().one()
                if row["status"] != "PENDING" or row["attempts"] >= limit:
                    raise ValueError("STRATEGIC_REVIEW_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED")
                db.execute(
                    tables.reviews.update().where(tables.reviews.c.job == parent).values(attempts=row["attempts"] + 1)
                )
                return {**row, "attempts": row["attempts"] + 1}
    
        def failed(self, parent, error):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                db.execute(tables.reviews.update().where(tables.reviews.c.job == parent).values(error=error))
    
        def complete(self, parent, advice):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                inputs = db.execute(
                    select(tables.reviews.c.inputs).where(
                        tables.reviews.c.job == parent, tables.reviews.c.status == "PENDING"
                    )
                ).scalar_one_or_none()
                if inputs is None:
                    return
                # Publish the factual baseline with its report. It participates in the
                # existing metadata checkpoint and is rewound with that report.
                observation = json.loads(inputs)["observation"]
                self.memory._set(db, "reviewPosition", review_position(observation))
                # Conversations resume before this civ's next gameplay observation.
                # Make the new report available from the trusted boundary snapshot.
                self.memory._advance_turn(db, observation["turn"])
                db.execute(
                    tables.reviews.update()
                    .where(tables.reviews.c.job == parent, tables.reviews.c.status == "PENDING")
                    .values(status="COMPLETED", inputs=None, advice=encode(advice), error=None)
                )
    
    
    def available_for_turn(turn):
        # Opening advice precedes the first move; periodic advice follows its source turn.
        return (tables.reviews.c.turn < turn) | ((tables.reviews.c.turn == 0) & (turn >= 0))
    
    
    def latest_advice(db, turn):
        """Freeze the opening or latest earlier end-of-turn report at dispatch."""
        if turn is None:
            return None
        row = (
            db.execute(
                select(tables.reviews.c.turn, tables.reviews.c.advice)
                .where(tables.reviews.c.status == "COMPLETED", available_for_turn(turn))
                .order_by(tables.reviews.c.turn.desc())
                .limit(1)
            )
            .mappings()
            .first()
        )
        return {"asOfTurn": row["turn"], **json.loads(row["advice"])} if row else None

            if not key.is_file():
                raise ContainerError(
                    "Diplomacy routing requires a separate OpenAI API key in AUTH_DIR/decisions.key (mode 600)"
                )
            from civ_agent.decisions_broker import read_decisions_key
    
            read_decisions_key(key)
    
    
    def ensure_decisions(root, image):
        private_directory(root / "decisions-ipc")
        with locked(root / ".decisions-launch.lock", wait=True):
            name = auth_name(root) + "-decisions"
            current = inspected(name)
            if current and current["State"]["Running"] and current.get("Image") != image:
                raise ContainerError(
                    "The shared Decisions broker uses a different runtime image. "
                    "Stop its affected games before replacing that broker, or select a separate auth directory."
                )
            if not current or not current["State"]["Running"]:
                if current:
                    podman("rm", name)
                (root / "decisions-ready.json").unlink(missing_ok=True)
                arguments = base_arguments(name, game_id="auth", resources=ContainerResources(memory_mib=512, cpus=0.5))
                podman(*arguments, "--network=pasta:-4", *mount(root, "/auth", writable=True), image, "decisions")
                podman("start", name)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
            while not (root / "decisions-ready.json").exists():
                current = inspected(name)
                if not current or not current["State"]["Running"] or time.monotonic() > deadline:
                    raise ContainerError("Decisions broker failed to start")
                time.sleep(0.2)
            # The ready file is not evidence that the player socket is reachable or
            # speaks this protocol. Authenticate with a trusted operator credential.
            authorize_agent(root, "operator", "health", root / "operator", decisions=True)
            health = routing_broker_health(root, timeout=5)
            if health["status"] != "ready":
                raise ContainerError(f"Decisions broker preflight failed: {health.get('reason', health['status'])}")
            report = {**health, "checkedAtMs": int(time.time() * 1000), "image": image}
            write_private_json(root / "decisions-preflight.json", report)
            return report
    
    
    def routing_broker_health(root, *, timeout=1):
        """Inspect the existing broker without starting it or calling the provider."""
        from civ_agent.decisions_broker import RoutingClient
    
        return asyncio.run(
            RoutingClient(root / "decisions-ipc/broker.sock", root / "operator/decisions-client.json").health(
                timeout=timeout
            )
        )
    
    
    def decisions_arguments(auth_root, name):
        return [
            *mount(auth_root / "decisions-ipc", "/decisions-ipc"),
            "--env",
            "CIV_DECISIONS_SOCKET=/decisions-ipc/broker.sock",
            "--env",
            f"CIV_DECISIONS_TOKEN_FILE=/match/agent-services/{name}/decisions-client.json",
        ]
    
    
    def authorize_agent(auth_root, game_id, seat, directory, *, decisions=False):
        path = directory / ("decisions-client.json" if decisions else "auth-client.json")
            records = json.loads(podman("container", "inspect", *self.names).stdout)
            for record in records:
                if not record["State"]["Running"]:
                    self.native_failure = {"container": record["Name"], "state": record["State"]}
                    raise ContainerError(
                        f"{record['Name']} exited: {record['State'].get('ExitCode')}; "
                        f"OOM killed: {record['State'].get('OOMKilled', False)}"
                    )
            return records
    
        def setup(self):
            validate_routing_credentials(self.config, self.auth_root)
            cleanup(self.game_id)
            self.record["launch"] = secrets.token_hex(6)
            write_private_json(self.root / "container.json", self.record)
            self.launch_dir = private_directory(self.root / "launches" / self.record["launch"])
            private_directory(self.root / "control")
            for name in ("start.json", "request.json"):
                (self.root / "control" / name).unlink(missing_ok=True)
            (self.root / "runtime.json").unlink(missing_ok=True)
            providers = {self.config.settings(p)["provider"] for p in self.config.agent_players}
            if self.config.agents.diplomacy_routing_enabled:
                self.record["routingPreflight"] = ensure_decisions(self.auth_root, self.record["images"]["runtime"])
                write_private_json(self.root / "container.json", self.record)
            if "openai" in providers:
                ensure_auth(self.auth_root, self.record["images"]["runtime"])
            if "openrouter" in providers:
                key = self.auth_root / "openrouter.key"
                if not key.is_file():
                    raise ContainerError(
                        "Run civ-agent auth login --provider openrouter before launching OpenRouter players"
                    )
                read_api_key(key)
            self.control_net = self.prefix + "-control"
            control = create_network(self.control_net, "cc" + self.game_id, internal=True)
            # A dedicated interface carries the browser; it never listens on player networks.
            from ipaddress import ip_network
    
            control_ip = str(ip_network(control["subnets"][0]["subnet"])[2])
            networks, bridges = [], []
            for index, player in enumerate(self.config.agent_players):
                network = f"{self.prefix}-p{index}"
                bridge = f"ca{self.game_id[:8]}{index}"
                create_network(network, bridge)
                networks.append(network)
                bridges.append(bridge)
                name = civilization_directory_name(player.civilization)
                directory = private_directory(self.root / "agent-services" / name)
                private_directory(self.root / "agents" / name)
                codex_home = private_directory(self.root / "codex" / name)
                # No personal home configuration, skills, login cache or history is imported.
                from civ_agent.tls import write_private
    
                write_private(codex_home / "config.toml", b'cli_auth_credentials_store = "ephemeral"\n')
                if self.config.settings(player)["provider"] == "openai":
                    authorize_agent(self.auth_root, self.game_id, index, directory)
                if self.config.agents.diplomacy_routing_enabled:
                    authorize_agent(self.auth_root, self.game_id, index, directory, decisions=True)
            firewall(self.game_id, bridges)
            resources = self.config.resources.desktop if self.config.human else self.config.resources.controller
            args = base_arguments(self.controller, game_id=self.game_id, resources=resources)
            args += [
                "--network",
                f"{self.control_net}:ip={control_ip},alias=game",
                "--sysctl",
                "net.ipv4.ip_forward=0",
                *mount(self.root, "/match", writable=True),
            ]
            for network in networks:
                args += ["--network", f"{network}:alias=game"]
            if self.config.human:
                args += [
                    "--publish",
                    f"127.0.0.1:{self.config.runtime.browser_port or ''}:6080",
                    "--env",
                    f"CIV_BROWSER_BIND={control_ip}",
                ]
            image = self.record["images"]["desktop" if self.config.human else "runtime"]
            self.start(args, self.controller, image, "controller")
            self.await_ready(lambda: read_json(self.root / "runtime.json", {}).get("phase") == "host_ready")
            if self.config.human:
                port = podman("port", self.controller, "6080/tcp").stdout.strip().rsplit(":", 1)[1]
                write_private_json(
                    self.root / "browser.json",
                    {"url": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/vnc.html?resize=scale", "password_file": "desktop/password.txt"},
                )
            for index, (player, network) in enumerate(zip(self.config.agent_players, networks, strict=True)):
                name = civilization_directory_name(player.civilization)
                container = f"{self.prefix}-p{index}"
                args = base_arguments(container, game_id=self.game_id, resources=self.config.resources.agent)
                args += ["--network", f"{network}:alias=p{index}"]
                for folder in ("agent-services", "agents", "codex"):
                    args += mount(self.root / folder / name, f"/match/{folder}/{name}", writable=True)
                args += agent_auth_arguments(self.auth_root, name, self.config.settings(player)["provider"])
                if self.config.agents.diplomacy_routing_enabled:
                    args += decisions_arguments(self.auth_root, name)
                args += [
                    "--env",
                    f"HOME=/match/codex/{name}",
                    "--env",
                    f"CODEX_HOME=/match/codex/{name}",
                ]
                self.start(args, container, self.record["images"]["runtime"], "agent", player.civilization)
            for container in self.names[1:]:
                with self.log_paths[container].open() as log:
                    self.await_ready(lambda: any(line.startswith("AGENT-READY:") for line in log.readlines()))
            write_private_json(self.root / "control/start.json", {"launch": self.record["launch"]})
    
        def stop(self):
            if self.controller in self.names:
                write_private_json(self.root / "control/request.json", {"action": "stop"})
            result.add_argument("--strategy-guide", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=None)
            result.add_argument("--civilization-guide", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=None)
            result.add_argument("--native-advice-enabled", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=None)
            result.add_argument("--diplomacy-routing-enabled", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=None)
            result.add_argument("--review-interval", type=int)
            result.add_argument("--review-attempts", type=int)
        return result
    
    
    def resolve_options(args):
        overrides = {}
        fields = {
            "game": (
                "master_seed",
                "map_seed",
                "starting_position_seed",
                "assignment_seed",
                "randomize",
                "civilizations",
                "city_states",
                "map_type",
                "map_size",
                "map_radius",
                "difficulty",
                "speed",
                "starting_era",
                "victories",
            ),
            "agents": (
                "provider",
                "model",
                "reasoning_effort",
                "communication_reasoning_effort",
                "fast",
                "strategy_guide",
                "civilization_guide",
                "native_advice_enabled",
                "diplomacy_routing_enabled",
                "review_interval",
                "review_attempts",
            ),
            "limits": ("max_turns", "max_invocations", "max_seconds", "turn_timeout", "startup_timeout"),
        }
        for section, names in fields.items():
            overrides[section] = {name: getattr(args, name) for name in names if getattr(args, name, None) is not None}
        if getattr(args, "map_radius", None) is not None:
            overrides["game"]["map_size"] = None
        if getattr(args, "map_size", None) is not None:
            overrides["game"]["map_radius"] = None
        overrides["runtime"] = {}
        for source, target in (("image", "image"), ("desktop_image", "desktop_image"), ("port", "browser_port")):
            if getattr(args, source, None) is not None:
                overrides["runtime"][target] = getattr(args, source)
        player_overrides = {}
        for option, setting in (
            ("player_providers", "provider"),
            ("player_models", "model"),
            ("player_reasoning_efforts", "reasoning_effort"),
            ("player_communication_reasoning_efforts", "communication_reasoning_effort"),
        ):
            for name, value in (getattr(args, option, None) or {}).items():
                player_overrides.setdefault(name, {})[setting] = value
        return load_config(getattr(args, "config", None), overrides, player_overrides=player_overrides).resolved()
    
    
    def initialize(root, config, auth_root, *, original=None, images=None, validation=None):
        if auth_root.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()):
            raise ContainerError("The provider credential directory must be outside the match directory")
        if (root / "resolved.json").exists() or (root / "exploration.json").exists():
            raise ContainerError("A saved game exists; use game resume or a new --state-dir")
        validate_routing_credentials(config, auth_root)
        images = images or {
            "runtime": resolve_image(config.runtime.image),
            **({"desktop": resolve_image(config.runtime.desktop_image)} if config.human else {}),
        }
        validation = validation or validate_setup(config, images["runtime"])
        if config.limits.max_turns is None:
            config.limits.max_turns = validation["maxTurns"] + 1
        private_directory(root)
        record = identity(root)
        from civ_agent.diplomacy_decisions import MODEL, POLICY_VERSION
    
        record.update(
            images=images,
            auth_root=str(auth_root),
            native_setup=validation,
            experiments={
                "native_advice_enabled": config.agents.native_advice_enabled,
                "diplomacy_routing_enabled": config.agents.diplomacy_routing_enabled,
                "nativeGuideVersion": "native-guidance-v1",
                "classifierModel": MODEL,
                "routingPolicyVersion": POLICY_VERSION,
            },
        )
        write_private_json(root / "container.json", record)
        write_private_json(root / "resolved.json", config.model_dump())
        if original is not None:
            write_private(root / "input.toml", original.read_bytes())
        return record
    
    
    def resume_configuration(root, args):
        config = ResolvedGameConfig.model_validate(read_json(root / "resolved.json"))
        record = identity(root)
        for key in ("max_turns", "max_invocations", "max_seconds", "turn_timeout", "startup_timeout"):
            value = getattr(args, key, None)
            if value is not None:
                if value < getattr(config.limits, key):
                    raise ValueError("Resume cannot decrease saved run limits")
                setattr(config.limits, key, value)
        if args.port is not None:
            config.runtime.browser_port = args.port
        if args.auth_dir is not None:
            record["auth_root"] = str(args.auth_dir.expanduser().resolve())
        for key, option in (("runtime", "image"), ("desktop", "desktop_image")):
            if getattr(args, option) is not None:
                    shutil.copytree(ASSETS.parents[1], staging)
                    staging.rename(engine)
                assets = engine / "android/assets"
                desktop(config, processes, logs)
            arguments = [
                "--data-dir",
                str(ROOT / "data"),
                "--mcp-config",
                str(ROOT / "players.json"),
                "--operator-config",
                str(ROOT / "operator.json"),
                "--tls-config",
                str(tls),
                "--port",
                "8765",
            ]
            if (ROOT / "exploration.json").exists():
                arguments += ["--resume-checkpoint", str(ROOT / "exploration.json")]
            else:
                arguments += ["--new-game", "--checkpoint", str(ROOT / "exploration.json"), *config.engine_arguments()]
            if config.human:
                arguments += ["--human", config.human]
            log = (ROOT / "host.log").open("a")
            logs.append(log)
            offset = log.tell()
            process = subprocess.Popen(native(arguments, assets), cwd=assets, stdout=log, stderr=log)
            processes.append(process)
            with (ROOT / "host.log").open() as reader:
                reader.seek(offset)
                wait_for(
                    lambda: any(line.startswith("MCP-READY:") for line in reader.readlines()),
                    process,
                    config.limits.startup_timeout,
                )
            write_private_json(ROOT / "runtime.json", {"phase": "host_ready", "launch": manifest["launch"]})
            wait_for(lambda: (ROOT / "control/start.json").exists(), process, config.limits.startup_timeout)
            args = scheduler.parser().parse_args(["--state-dir", str(ROOT)])
            args.action = "resume" if read_record(path_for(ROOT), "state", "run") else "start"
            # Per-seat service settings own the model choice, including opening reviews.
            args.model = args.reasoning_effort = None
            for key, value in config.limits.model_dump().items():
                if key != "startup_timeout":
                    setattr(args, key, value)
            write_private_json(ROOT / "runtime.json", {"phase": "running", "launch": manifest["launch"]})
            code = scheduler.run(args)
            state = read_record(path_for(ROOT), "state", "run") or {}
            write_private_json(
                ROOT / "runtime.json",
                {
                    "phase": "stopped",
                    "launch": manifest["launch"],
                    "exit_code": code,
                    "runner_status": state.get("status"),
                    "reason": state.get("reason") or (f"Scheduler exited {code}; inspect controller log" if code else None),
                },
            )
            return code
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            return 130
        finally:
            # A second stop request must not interrupt flushing/child cleanup.
            for sig in original_handlers:
                signal.signal(sig, signal.SIG_IGN)
            for process in reversed(processes):
                stop(process)
            for log in logs:
    """Launch one civilization's HTTPS Codex service in the foreground."""
    
    import argparse
    import errno
    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    import secrets
    import shutil
    import sys
    from pathlib import Path
    
    from aiohttp import web
    
    from civ_agent.agent_service import AgentService, ServiceError, server_ssl_context
    from civ_agent.agent_settings import add_settings_arguments, setting_argument
    from civ_agent.civilization_guide import UnsupportedCivilizationGuideError, civilization_reference
    from civ_agent.civilization_state import MemoryFormatError
    from civ_agent.providers import PROVIDERS
    from civ_agent.scheduler import positive
    from civ_agent.tls import (
        TLSConfigError,
        endpoint_configuration,
        ensure_server_certificate,
        host_origin,
        private_directory,
        regular_file,
        write_private_json,
    )
    from civ_agent.turn_archive import civilization_directory_name
    
    
    def parser(*, add_help: bool = True) -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
        result = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, add_help=add_help)
        result.add_argument("civilization", help="Fixed civilization served by this process, e.g. Rome")
        result.add_argument(
            "--state-dir",
            type=Path,
            default=Path(os.environ.get("UNCIV_HOST_DIR", "~/.local/state/unciv-host/demo")).expanduser(),
        )
        result.add_argument("--service-dir", type=Path, help="Independent durable service state directory")
        result.add_argument("--workspace", type=Path, help="This civilization's Codex working directory")
        result.add_argument("--mcp-url", help="Permitted HTTPS host MCP endpoint; inferred from endpoints.json by default")
        result.add_argument("--mcp-ca-file", type=Path, help="Additional trusted CA for the host MCP endpoint")
        result.add_argument(
            "--port", type=int, default=None, help="HTTPS port (Rome:8865, Greece:8866, France:8867; required for others)"
        )
        result.add_argument("--listen-host", default="127.0.0.1")
        result.add_argument(
            "--public-host", default="localhost", help="Hostname clients use; included in generated certificate"
        )
        result.add_argument(
            "--cert-file", type=Path, help="Existing service HTTPS certificate, with --key-file and --ca-file"
        )
        result.add_argument("--key-file", type=Path)
        result.add_argument("--ca-file", type=Path, help="CA clients trust for this service certificate")
        result.add_argument("--token-file", type=Path, help="Existing service bearer token file (created if absent)")
        result.add_argument("--codex", default="codex", help="Codex executable path")
        result.add_argument("--provider", choices=PROVIDERS, default="openai")
        result.add_argument(
            "--fast", action="store_true", help="Request Codex fast priority for gameplay and background work"
        )
        result.add_argument(
            "--strategy-guide",
            action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction,
            default=False,
            help="Include optional Civ V strategy suggestions in agent context (default: off)",
        )
        result.add_argument(
            "--civilization-guide",
            action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction,
            default=False,
            help="Include optional advice for this civilization after the strategy guide (default: off)",
        )
        result.add_argument(
            "--memory-context-chars",
            type=int,
            default=12000,
            help="Private memory context limit for fresh jobs (default: 12000 characters)",
        )
        result.add_argument(
            "--review-interval",
            type=positive,
            default=5,
            help="Concurrent opening strategy before the first move, then every k turns (default: 5)",
        )
        result.add_argument(
            "--review-attempts", type=positive, default=3, help="Maximum attempts per background review (default: 3)"
        )
        add_settings_arguments(
            result,
            model_help="Default model for new conversations; civ-agent match start --model overrides it",
            reasoning_help="Default reasoning effort for new conversations; civ-agent match start --reasoning-effort overrides it",
        )
        result.add_argument(
            "--communication-reasoning-effort",
            type=setting_argument,
            metavar="LEVEL",
            help="Reasoning effort for background diplomacy; defaults to at most medium for known effort levels",
        )
        result.add_argument("--native-advice-enabled", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=False)
        result.add_argument("--diplomacy-routing-enabled", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=False)
        return result
    
    
    def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        port = args.port
        os.umask(0o077)
        try:
            if not args.civilization.strip() or len(args.civilization) > 128:
                raise ServiceError("INVALID_CIVILIZATION")
            if args.civilization_guide:
                civilization_reference(args.civilization)
            port = (
                args.port
                if args.port is not None
                else {"Rome": 8865, "Greece": 8866, "France": 8867}.get(args.civilization)
            )
            if port is None or not 1 <= port <= 65535:
                raise ServiceError("INVALID_PORT")
            root = args.state_dir.expanduser().resolve()
            identity = civilization_directory_name(args.civilization)
            service_dir = private_directory((args.service_dir or root / "agent-services" / identity).expanduser().resolve())
            workspace = private_directory((args.workspace or root / "agents" / identity).expanduser().resolve())
            endpoint, mcp_ca = endpoint_configuration(root, args.mcp_url, args.mcp_ca_file)
            material_options = (args.cert_file, args.key_file, args.ca_file)
            if any(material_options) and not all(material_options):
                raise ServiceError("CERTIFICATE_KEY_AND_CA_REQUIRED")
            if all(material_options):
                material = dict(
                    zip(
                        ("cert_file", "key_file", "ca_file"),
                        (path.expanduser().resolve() for path in material_options),
                        strict=True,
                    )
                )
            else:
                material = ensure_server_certificate(
                    root,
                    "agent-" + hashlib.sha256(args.civilization.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    ["localhost", "127.0.0.1", args.public_host],
                )
            token_file = (args.token_file or service_dir / "token.json").expanduser().resolve()
            if any(path.is_relative_to(workspace) for path in (service_dir, token_file, material["key_file"])):
                raise ServiceError("PRIVATE_STATE_INSIDE_WORKSPACE")
            if not token_file.exists():
                write_private_json(token_file, {"token": secrets.token_urlsafe(32)})
            regular_file(token_file, private=True)
            credential = json.loads(token_file.read_text())
            if not isinstance(credential, dict) or set(credential) != {"token"}:
                raise ServiceError("INVALID_SERVICE_TOKEN")
            token = credential["token"]
            if (
                not isinstance(token, str)
                or len(token) != 43
                or any(
                    character not in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_-"
                    for character in token
                )
            ):
                raise ServiceError("INVALID_SERVICE_TOKEN")
            executable = shutil.which(args.codex)
            if executable is None:
                raise ServiceError("CODEX_NOT_FOUND")
            ssl_context = server_ssl_context(material["cert_file"], material["key_file"])
            service = AgentService(
                args.civilization,
                workspace,
                service_dir,
                token,
                endpoint + "/mcp",
                mcp_ca,
                executable,
                model=args.model,
                provider=args.provider,
                reasoning_effort=args.reasoning_effort,
                communication_reasoning_effort=args.communication_reasoning_effort,
                memory_context_chars=args.memory_context_chars,
                review_interval=args.review_interval,
                review_attempts=args.review_attempts,
                strategy_guide=args.strategy_guide,
                civilization_guide=args.civilization_guide,
                native_advice_enabled=args.native_advice_enabled,
                diplomacy_routing_enabled=args.diplomacy_routing_enabled,
                fast=args.fast,
                gateway_url=host_origin(args.public_host, port) + "/mcp",
                gateway_ca_file=material["ca_file"],
            )
            url = host_origin(args.public_host, port) + "/agent"
            # This file is operator-only discovery. Neither its bearer token nor the host's
            # operator credentials are ever given to the model subprocess.
            discovery = root / "agent-services" / identity / "endpoint.json"
            write_private_json(
                discovery,
                {
                    "civilizationId": args.civilization,
                    "url": url,
                    "tokenFile": str(token_file),
                    "caFile": str(material["ca_file"]),
                },
            )
            print(f"Starting {args.civilization} agent service at {url}", flush=True)
            print(f"Player turn files: {workspace}", flush=True)
            print(f"Service diagnostics: {service.diagnostics.path}", flush=True)
            print(f"Strategy guide: {'enabled (optional suggestions)' if args.strategy_guide else 'disabled'}", flush=True)
            print(
                f"Civilization guide: {'enabled (optional suggestions)' if args.civilization_guide else 'disabled'}",
                flush=True,
            )
            print(f"Provider: {args.provider}; requested service tier: {'fast' if service.fast else 'default'}", flush=True)
            print(
                f"New conversation defaults: model={args.model or 'Codex config'}, reasoning={args.reasoning_effort or 'Codex config'}",
                flush=True,
            )
            print(
                "Background diplomacy reasoning: "

    def authorize_agent(auth_root, game_id, seat, directory, *, decisions=False):
        path = directory / ("decisions-client.json" if decisions else "auth-client.json")
        if not path.exists():
            write_private_json(path, {"token": secrets.token_urlsafe(32)})
        token = read_json(path)["token"]
        with locked(auth_root / ".clients.lock", wait=True):
            registry = auth_root / ("decisions-clients.json" if decisions else "clients.json")
            clients = read_json(registry, {})
            clients[f"{game_id}-{seat}"] = hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest()
            write_private_json(registry, clients)

    def agent(civilization):
        from civ_agent.commands import agent_server
    
        name = civilization_directory_name(civilization)
        directory = ROOT / "agent-services" / name
        launch = json.loads((directory / "container-settings.json").read_text())
        if launch["civilization"] != civilization:
            raise ValueError("Agent identity differs from its private configuration")
        security = directory / "security"
        arguments = [
            civilization,
            "--state-dir",
            str(ROOT),
            "--port",
            "8766",
            "--listen-host",
            "0.0.0.0",
            "--public-host",
            launch["hostname"],
            "--mcp-url",
            "https://game:8765",
            "--mcp-ca-file",
            str(security / "ca.pem"),
            "--cert-file",
            str(security / "cert.pem"),
            "--key-file",
            str(security / "key.pem"),
            "--ca-file",
            str(security / "ca.pem"),
        ]
        for key, value in launch["settings"].items():
            if isinstance(value, bool):
                if value:
                    arguments.append("--" + key.replace("_", "-"))
            else:
                arguments += ["--" + key.replace("_", "-"), str(value)]
        return agent_server.run(agent_server.parser().parse_args(arguments))

                    val shown = turn.map.tiles.firstOrNull { it.position == move.destination && it.visible } ?: return@mapNotNull null
                    val tile = player.gameInfo.tileMap[shown.position.x, shown.position.y]
                    if (shown.owner?.let { player.gameInfo.ruleset.nations[it]?.isCityState } == true || terrainDamage(shown) != 0) return@mapNotNull null
                    if (visibleHostiles.any { other -> tile.aerialDistanceTo(player.gameInfo.tileMap[other.position.x, other.position.y]) <= 3 }) return@mapNotNull null
                    val height = terrainHeight(shown) ?: return@mapNotNull null
                    val unseen = tile.getTilesAtDistance(unit.getVisibilityRange()).count { TilePosition(it.position.x, it.position.y) !in observedTiles }
                    if (tile.getTilesInDistance(unit.getVisibilityRange()).none { TilePosition(it.position.x, it.position.y) !in observedTiles }) return@mapNotNull null

                        action(
                            Native.Kind.Move,
                            observed.handle,

            } else {

                    val found = position == observed.position

                        action(
                            if (found) Native.Kind.FoundCity else Native.Kind.Move,
                            observed.handle,
                            if (found) "FOUND_CITY" else "MOVE_UNIT",
                            destination = position.takeUnless { found },
                            cost = if (found) obj("consumesUnit" to true) else obj("movement" to observed.moves.first { it.destination == position }.movementCost),
                        ),
                        values,
                        player.gameInfo.ruleset.modOptions.constants.minimumCityLocationTileValue,
                        turn.turn == 0 && turn.cities.isEmpty() && turn.map.units.count { it.settlement != null } == 1,

            // within three tiles, so derive its input from the complete permitted map.
            // Neither a live foreign unit nor the engine's omniscient threat cache is read.
            val nearestObservedEnemy = visibleHostiles.minOfOrNull { hostile ->
                player.gameInfo.tileMap[observed.position.x, observed.position.y].aerialDistanceTo(player.gameInfo.tileMap[hostile.position.x, hostile.position.y])
            } ?: Int.MAX_VALUE
