    | --- | ---: | ---: |
    | Mean cities | 3.08 | 2.63 |
    | Mean population | 19.75 | 18.88 |
    | Mean current production | 33.75 | 33.63 |
    | Mean science per turn | 41.25 | 45.00 |
    | Mean culture per turn | 12.42 | 18.75 |
    | Mean researched technology count | 15.92 | 15.13 |
    | Mean score | 217.00 | 197.38 |
    | Completed National Colleges | 8/12 | 8/8 |
    | Negative-happiness seat-turns, latest 20 rounds | 42/240 | 0/160 |
    
    Terra's lower technology count remains relevant: higher current science output
    does not establish a cumulative research lead. Its smaller footprint is also
    still visible. Nevertheless, maintaining nearly the same population and
    production with fewer cities, while avoiding negative happiness throughout this
    window, supports a favorable assessment of its economic management. Its average
    score deficit to Luna has narrowed from about 30 to 20 points.
    
    Luna's best positions should not disappear inside those averages. Mixed game 3
    Persia added nine population and 16 production over 20 rounds. Mixed game 2
    Arabia and all-Luna game 2 France are also developing strong economies. Conversely,
    Terra's two Incan seats still have only two cities and low production. The game 3
    seat has a Settler and a conditional route plan; game 4 Inca has actually founded
    its second city and added eight population over the latest 20 rounds. The earlier
    one-city criticism no longer describes that position.
    
    **The all-Luna batch is competitive with its controls at this stage, with large
    variation between seats.** Twelve of 20 model seats lead their native control's
    score: none in game 1, and four in each remaining game. Mean population is 17.8
    versus the controls' 17.25, production 33.4 versus 35.75, and science 34.3 versus
    24.25. The research-output advantage is substantial, but technology count still
    slightly trails, 14.65 versus 15.25. Nine of 20 National Colleges are complete.
    This does not yet reproduce the severe population and production deficits seen
    much later in the retired first-attempt batch; the different turn horizons also
    prevent claiming that those later problems have been solved.
    
    **The most persistent economic mistake is allowing bottlenecks to survive while
    preserving reserves or pursuing another build.** All-Luna game 1 France's
    turn-90 review identifies a National College with stored production that had
    been displaced by a Worker, then blocked by another city's missing Library.
    At the new cutoff, the College is still queued. Expansion without coordinating
    the Library requirement has delayed the intended science payoff.
    
    Mixed game 1 Inca has 811 gold, only one Worker, 20 production and an unfinished
    National College; its turn-100 review estimates another 13 turns to finish it.
    Arabia in the same game holds 807 gold and has endured 19 unhappy rounds out of
    20, adding just one population. It has recently recovered to positive happiness,
    but its Library and College sequence remains late. All-Luna game 4 China's
    1,227-gold reserve also deserves a concrete comparison against purchases and
    expansion. A large treasury alone is not a mistake; these cases combine it with
    observable development constraints. The evidence does not establish the optimal
    purchase without evaluating available prices, alternatives and reserve needs.
    
    Happiness recovery is uneven. All-Luna game 3 China was unhappy in 17 of the
    latest 20 rounds and added only one population; it is now positive. The mixed
    batch's Terra seats have no negative-happiness rounds in that window. These
    differences matter more than whether a review correctly names happiness as a
    priority: the outcome is how quickly growth resumes.
    
    **Combat now supplies evidence beyond intentions.** All-Luna game 3 Arabia
    declared on native France at turn 91. Its receipts confirm six French unit kills
    through turn 98: two Archers, two Scouts, a Spearman and a Swordsman. It repeatedly
    uses city bombardment and ranged fire before committing melee units. Its own
    Archer disappears from the owned roster after turn 94, so this is not evidence
    of a lossless campaign. At turn 101 a Pikeman counterattack leaves a French
    Horseman at 10 health; that is damage, not a seventh confirmed kill.
    
    All-Luna game 3 Greece declared on Inca at 99 and destroyed Slingers at 100 and
    101 through coordinated city/unit attacks. Mixed game 3 Terra Greece captured
    an Arabian Worker at 99 with a Scout. The immediate attack caused no damage,
    but Damascus then dealt 74 damage to the Scout and an Arabian Archer destroyed
    it. Greece still owns the captured Worker and moved it away on turns 100 and
    101. This is a Worker-for-Scout exchange with an ongoing war, not a free raid.
    It exposes a concrete planning weakness: a favorable immediate combat preview
    does not account for the opponent's next turn. None of the model seats currently
    holds a foreign-founded city, so these actions demonstrate raids and border
    combat rather than successful retained city conquest.
    
    **The feedback mechanisms are visible, but the outcomes remain inconsistent.**
    Recent reviews distinguish queued construction from completion and accepted
    attacks from confirmed kills. For example, mixed game 1 Inca's review explicitly
    notes that a 3-HP Brute remains alive after the accepted attack. Historical
    progress includes changes in happiness, exploration, construction and units.
    That supplies useful evidence to the player; the remaining delayed Colleges and
    idle reserves show that supplying evidence does not guarantee timely decisions.
    
    Exploration also needs a more selective assessment. All-Luna game 4 China
    revealed 185 tiles over its latest 20 rounds, a substantial recovery from its
    earlier problem. Across the batch, however, eight of 20 Luna seats revealed fewer
    than ten tiles. Mixed-batch counts are three of 12 Luna and one of eight Terra.
    Some low exploration is explained by war or geography, so these counts identify
    positions to examine rather than proving every Scout was mismanaged.
    
    No captured model city is running Gold, Science or Culture conversion. This is
    consistent with the enforced final-era restriction. It is not independent
    evidence that the models would now choose infrastructure voluntarily, and these
    runs do not provide a controlled estimate of the five fixes' effects.
    
    **Diplomacy still devotes substantial attention to distant victory projects.**
    Across the latest 20-round windows, 114 of 225 unique all-Luna messages (51%) and
    73 of 223 mixed messages (33%) mention Apollo, spaceship, Utopia, terminal or
    United Nations/UN. The keyword count includes useful mixed-topic messages; it
    does not label every matching message useless. Repeated reports of projects
    that have not begun nevertheless remain prominent at roughly turn 100.
    
    Real trades occur: the captured current-timeline shared proposals contain 17
    enacted versus 35 expired in all-Luna, and 12 enacted versus nine expired in
    mixed. These are proposal-version outcomes, not a conversion rate for every
    offer ever made. Expiration is a host deadline outcome; these records alone do
    not separate scheduling/delivery delays from player inaction. Conversation
    context should be judged by completed negotiations, not message volume alone.
    
    **Terra's gains come with substantially slower observed turns.** In the mixed
    batch's latest 20 completed rounds, median gameplay time is 238 seconds for
    Terra versus 65 seconds for Luna, about 3.6 times as long. Mean reported input
    plus output is about 620,000 versus 315,000 tokens, including cached input;
    uncached input is about 80,000 versus 55,000. This is not a monetary cost ratio.
    The sample contains 160 Terra and 240 Luna completed gameplay jobs and excludes
    chat, reviews, incomplete retries and finalization. The development results do
    not yet establish an overall strength advantage sufficient to offset that
    throughput difference; a completed-game comparison remains necessary.
    
    At the **13:55 UTC operational recheck**, all four all-Luna games and mixed games
    2–4 were running. Mixed game 1 remained paused after five automatic retries for
    unavailable model capacity. Mixed game 3 had recovered from the capacity retry
    observed at capture. These are operational conditions, not gameplay defeats.
    
    The next gameplay checkpoints should examine whether the remaining Colleges and
    Universities actually finish, whether newly positive happiness produces growth,
    whether large reserves address specific constraints, and whether wars yield
    retained benefits after casualties and disruption. Raw score and immediate
    attack success are insufficient by themselves.
    
    **Evidence and limits.** The audit copied atomic turn-recovery saves and used
    read-only SQLite transactions. Comparisons use each game's last fully completed
    round; city assets and queues come from the associated boundary save. Science
    and culture use the stored completed-turn outputs. Production includes current
    construction modifiers and temporary effects, so it is not normalized capacity.
    Command receipts, reviews and reachable observation histories are limited to
    the cutoff. Telemetry deduplicates completed turns across recovery attempts;
    diplomacy counts use the captured current recovery epoch.
    
    The native save omits default `diplomaticStatus: War` values. This extraction
    correctly restores that default; omitted status must not be interpreted as
    peace. The earlier snapshot's derived war lists should not be used for historical
    peace/war comparisons. No runtime, gameplay configuration or game state was
    changed during this assessment.

    """Read-only gameplay evidence at copied turn-boundary cutoffs; no game/model calls."""
    
    import collections
    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    import re
    import sqlite3
    from contextlib import contextmanager
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    from pathlib import Path
    
    from civ_agent.game_config import ResolvedGameConfig
    from civ_agent.match_recovery import digest
    
    os.umask(0o077)
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    REPO = ROOT.parents[1]
    BATCHES = ('all-luna-attempt-2-0', 'luna-terra-attempt-1-0')
    
    
    def write(path, data):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
    
    
    @contextmanager
    def database(path):
        db = sqlite3.connect(path.resolve().as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True, timeout=2)
        db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        try:
            db.execute('BEGIN')
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()
    
    
    def rows(db, query, args=(), json_columns=()):
        result = []
        for value in db.execute(query, args):
            row = dict(value)
            for key in json_columns:
                row[key] = json.loads(row[key]) if row[key] else None
            result.append(row)
        return result
    
    
    captured = []
    for batch in BATCHES:
        for folder in sorted((REPO / 'benchmarks' / batch / 'games').glob('g*')):
            raw = (folder / 'turn-recovery/current.json').read_bytes()
            recovery = json.loads(raw)
            assert digest(recovery['host']) == recovery['hostSha256']
            native = json.loads(recovery['host']['gameJson'])
            config = ResolvedGameConfig.model_validate(json.loads((folder / 'resolved.json').read_text()))
            with database(folder / 'runner/monitoring.sqlite3') as db:
                state = {r['key']: json.loads(r['payload']) for r in db.execute(
                    "SELECT key,payload FROM monitor_records WHERE collection='state'")}
            source = {
                'batch': batch, 'game': folder.name, 'captured_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                'source': str(folder.relative_to(REPO)), 'turn': native['turns'],
                'completed_turn': native['turns'] - 1, 'epoch': recovery['epoch'],
                'handoff': recovery['handoff'], 'recovery_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                'game_sha256': hashlib.sha256(recovery['host']['gameJson'].encode()).hexdigest(),
                'host_revision': state['result']['hostRevision'], 'engine_revision': state['result']['engineRevision'],
                'runtime_image': json.loads((folder / 'container.json').read_text())['images']['runtime'],
                'container_status': json.loads((folder / 'container-status.json').read_text())['status'],
                'run_status': state['run'].get('status'),
                'players': config.player_records(),
                'game_settings': config.game.model_dump(), 'agent_settings': config.agents.model_dump(),
            }
            out = ROOT / batch / folder.name
            write(out / 'source.json', source)
            write(out / 'game.json', native)
            write(out / 'result.json', state['result'])
            captured.append((folder, out, source, native))
            print(batch, folder.name, 'completed round', source['completed_turn'], flush=True)
    
    summaries = []
    for folder, out, source, native in captured:
        end = source['completed_turn']
        units = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for tile in native['tileMap']['tileList']:
            on_tile = [tile[key] for key in ('militaryUnit', 'civilianUnit') if key in tile]
            for unit in on_tile + tile.get('airUnits', []):
                units[unit['owner']].append({**unit, 'position': tile.get('position', {})})
        players = {player['civilization']: player for player in source['players']}
        summary = {'batch': source['batch'], 'game': source['game'], 'completed_turn': end,
                   'captured_utc': source['captured_utc'], 'civilizations': []}
        for civ in native['civilizations']:
            name = civ['civName']
            if name not in players:
                continue
            history = {int(t): {k: int(n) for k, n in re.findall(r'([A-Z])(-?\d+)', stats)}
                       for t, stats in civ['statsHistory'].items()}
            assert end in history
            city_list = []
            for city in civ.get('cities', []):
                construction = city['cityConstructions']
                city_list.append({k: city.get(k) for k in (
                    'id', 'name', 'foundingCiv', 'turnAcquired', 'location', 'isOriginalCapital',
                    'health', 'population', 'connectedToCapitalStatus', 'puppet', 'focus')})
                city_list[-1].update({
                    'queue': construction.get('constructionQueue', []),
                    'buildings': construction.get('builtBuildings', []),
                    'in_progress': construction.get('inProgressConstructions', {}),
                    'specialists': city['population'].get('specialistAllocations', {}),
                })
            summary['civilizations'].append({
                'name': name, 'player': players[name], 'stats': history[end],
                'delta_20': {key: value - history[max(0, end-20)][key] for key, value in history[end].items()},
                'negative_happiness_last20': sum(history[t]['H'] < 0 for t in range(max(0,end-19),end+1)),
                'science_last_completed': civ['tech']['scienceOfLast8Turns'][end % 8],
                'culture_last_completed': civ['policies'].get('cultureOfLast8Turns', [0]*8)[end % 8],
                'tech_queue': civ['tech'].get('techsToResearch', []),
                'techs': civ['tech'].get('techsResearched', []),
                'policies': civ['policies'].get('adoptedPolicies', []),
                'cities': city_list, 'units': units[name], 'history': history,
                'wars': [name for name, d in civ.get('diplomacy',{}).items() if d.get('diplomaticStatus', 'War') == 'War'],
                'active_trades': {name:d['trades'] for name,d in civ.get('diplomacy',{}).items() if d.get('trades')},
            })
        with database(folder / 'runner/monitoring.sqlite3') as db:
            # Preserve epochs so interrupted/discarded attempts are distinguishable.
            for collection in ('turns', 'jobs', 'diplomacy'):
                records = rows(db, """SELECT civilization,game_turn,epoch,payload FROM monitor_records
                    WHERE collection=? AND game_turn BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY revision""",
                    (collection, max(0,end-19),end), ('payload',))
                write(out / f'{collection}.json', records)
        for player in source['players']:
            if player['controller'] != 'agent':
                continue
            name = player['civilization']
            with database(folder / f'agent-services/{name}/civilization/memory.sqlite3') as db:
                reviews = rows(db, """SELECT job,turn,status,advice,error FROM reviews
                    WHERE turn<=? ORDER BY turn DESC LIMIT 3""", (end,), ('advice',))
                write(out / f'{name}-reviews.json', reviews)
                calls = rows(db, """SELECT c.rowid,c.job,c.name,c.arguments,c.result,j.epoch,j.game_turn,j.purpose,j.status
                    FROM calls c JOIN jobs j ON j.id=c.job
                    WHERE (j.game_turn BETWEEN ? AND ? OR j.game_turn IS NULL)
                    AND c.name IN ('player_command','chat_send','trade_offer','trade_decide','trade_prepare',
                      'trade_read','commitment_offer','commitment_decide','agreement_read','memory_update')
                    ORDER BY c.rowid""", (max(0,end-19),end), ('arguments','result'))
                write(out / f'{name}-calls.json', calls)
                observations = rows(db, """WITH RECURSIVE reachable(key,version) AS (
                    SELECT key,version FROM heads WHERE key IN
                      ('observation:overview','observation:economy','observation:tactics',
                       'observation:victory_progress','observation:policy','observation:game')
                    UNION SELECT r.key,r.parent FROM records r JOIN reachable h
                      ON r.key=h.key AND r.version=h.version WHERE r.parent IS NOT NULL
                ), eligible AS (
                    SELECT r.key,r.version,r.body,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.key ORDER BY r.version DESC) AS rn
                    FROM records r JOIN reachable h ON r.key=h.key AND r.version=h.version
                    WHERE json_extract(r.body,'$.turn')<=?
                ) SELECT key,version,body FROM eligible WHERE rn=1""", (end,), ('body',))
                write(out / f'{name}-observations.json', observations)
        summaries.append(summary)
    write(ROOT / 'summary.json', summaries)
    print('Captured and extracted', len(summaries), 'games', flush=True)

    """Operator-owned bounds shared by configuration, services and the trusted broker."""
    
    import argparse
    from typing import Annotated
    
    from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator
    
    
    class DecisionsSettings(BaseModel):
        model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", validate_default=True, allow_inf_nan=False)
    
        decisions_enabled: bool = False
        additional_decisions_budget_usd: Annotated[float, Field(ge=0, le=1000)] = 0.10
        decisions_min_confidence: Annotated[float, Field(ge=0, le=1)] = 0.90
        decisions_timeout_seconds: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1, le=5)] = 5
        decisions_startup_min_gap_turns: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] = 5
        decisions_max_request_bytes: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1024, le=65536)] = 65536
        decisions_max_questions: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1, le=64)] = 64
        decisions_memory_candidate_limit: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1, le=16)] = 16
        decisions_preservation_candidate_limit: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1, le=8)] = 8
        decisions_belief_candidate_limit: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1, le=6)] = 6
        early_review_min_gap_turns: Annotated[int, Field(ge=3)] = 3
        early_review_min_gap_between_early_turns: Annotated[int, Field(ge=10)] = 10
        memory_context_chars: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1000)] = 12000
    
        @model_validator(mode="before")
        @classmethod
        def reject_retired(cls, value):
            if isinstance(value, dict) and "diplomacy_routing_enabled" in value:
                raise ValueError("diplomacy_routing_enabled is retired; explicitly choose decisions_enabled instead")
            return value
    
    
    DECISIONS_FIELDS = tuple(DecisionsSettings.model_fields)
    
    
    class RetiredDecisionsFlag(argparse.Action):
        def __call__(self, parser, namespace, values, option_string=None):
            parser.error(f"{option_string} is retired; explicitly choose --decisions-enabled or --no-decisions-enabled")
    
    
    def add_decisions_arguments(parser, *, defaults=True, include_memory=True):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--diplomacy-routing-enabled",
            "--no-diplomacy-routing-enabled",
            action=RetiredDecisionsFlag,
            nargs=0,
            help=argparse.SUPPRESS,
        )
        for name, field in DecisionsSettings.model_fields.items():
            if name == "memory_context_chars" and not include_memory:
                continue
            options = {"default": field.default if defaults else None}
            if name == "decisions_enabled":
                options["action"] = argparse.BooleanOptionalAction
            else:
                options["type"] = type(field.default)
            parser.add_argument("--" + name.replace("_", "-"), **options)
    
    
    def decisions_values(source):
        return {name: getattr(source, name) for name in DECISIONS_FIELDS}
    """One coordinated turn boundary, used automatically by match resume."""
    
    import contextlib
    import hashlib
    import json
    import time
    import uuid
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, wait
    from pathlib import Path
    
    from civ_agent.monitoring import MonitorStore, path_for
    from civ_agent.tls import private_directory, write_private_json
    
    HEARTBEAT_SECONDS = 3
    
    
    def digest(value):
        return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
    
    
    class TurnCoordinator:
        def __init__(self, root, operator, agents, lease):
            self.root = private_directory(Path(root) / "turn-recovery")
            self.operator, self.agents, self.lease = operator, agents, lease
    
        def call_agent(self, agent, operation, **fields):
            # A single service operation can outlast the host's lease (restoring
            # histories and memories, for example). Renew while it is in flight,
            # keeping all operator calls on the coordinating thread. If renewal
            # fails, finish this request before leaving the services fenced.
            self.operator.call("heartbeat", leaseId=self.lease)
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix="turn-recovery") as worker:
                pending = worker.submit(agent.call, operation, **fields)
                while not wait([pending], timeout=HEARTBEAT_SECONDS).done:
                    self.operator.call("heartbeat", leaseId=self.lease)
                return pending.result()
    
        def quiesce(self):
            try:
                self._quiesce()
            except BaseException:
                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                    self.operator.call("barrier", leaseId=self.lease)
                raise
    
        def _quiesce(self):
            # Stop proposal approval first; already dispatched requests may complete.
            # The model computations need not finish to reach this boundary.
            for agent in self.agents.values():
                self.call_agent(agent, "barrier", paused=True)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 45
            while True:
                if all(self.call_agent(agent, "barrier", paused=True)["ready"] for agent in self.agents.values()):
                    break
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise ValueError("Services did not reach the checkpoint barrier; match remains paused.")
                time.sleep(0.25)
            self.operator.call("barrier", leaseId=self.lease)
    
        def release(self):
            for agent in self.agents.values():
                self.call_agent(agent, "barrier", paused=False)
            self.operator.call("unbarrier", leaseId=self.lease)
    
        def capture(self, status, scheduler):
            target = self.root / "current.json"
            if target.exists():
                previous = json.loads(target.read_text())
                if (previous["epoch"], previous["handoff"]) == (status["epoch"], status["handoff"]):
                    return
            id = status["epoch"] + "-handoff-" + str(status["handoff"]) + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
            self.quiesce()
            try:
                host = self.operator.call("snapshot", leaseId=self.lease)["checkpoint"]
                components = {}
                for civilization, agent in self.agents.items():
                    components[civilization] = self.call_agent(agent, "snapshot", id=id)
                # Publication is the commit point: partial components are deliberately
                # not discoverable as restore points without this complete manifest.
                write_private_json(
                    target,
                    {
                        "id": id,
                        "turn": status["turn"],
                        "handoff": status["handoff"],
                        "epoch": status["epoch"],
                        "host": host,
                        "hostSha256": digest(host),
                        "players": components,
                        "scheduler": scheduler,
                    },
                )
                for agent in self.agents.values():
                    self.call_agent(agent, "retain_snapshot", id=id)
            except BaseException:
                # Leave every service fenced on failure. Explicit resume can retry.
                raise
            else:
                self.release()
    
        def restore(self, manifest, scheduler):
            if set(manifest["players"]) != set(self.agents) or digest(manifest["host"]) != manifest["hostSha256"]:
                raise ValueError("Checkpoint verification failed")
            journal = self.root / "restore.json"
            previous = json.loads(journal.read_text()) if journal.exists() else None
            if previous and not previous.get("complete") and previous["checkpoint"] != manifest["id"]:
                raise ValueError("Turn recovery refers to another checkpoint")
            epoch = (
                previous["epoch"]
                if previous and previous["checkpoint"] == manifest["id"] and not previous.get("complete")
                else "g" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]
            )
            self.quiesce()
            if not previous or previous.get("complete"):
                write_private_json(
                    journal,
                    {
                        "checkpoint": manifest["id"],
                        "epoch": epoch,
                        "complete": False,
                        "usage": scheduler.get("usage", {}),
                        "invocations": scheduler.get("invocations", 0),
                    },
                )
            # Verify all remote components before replacing any component.
            for civilization, agent in self.agents.items():
                checked = self.call_agent(agent, "verify_snapshot", **manifest["players"][civilization])
                if not checked.get("valid"):
                    raise ValueError("A civilization checkpoint failed verification")
            for agent in self.agents.values():

    REVIEW 80 {'assessment': 'Prefer Plan 1 as a broad, flexible science direction—not as a guaranteed science finish. France’s Utopia Project is locked behind five completed policy branches. Thus neither finish is imminent from the evidence.', 'plans': [{'expectedObservations': ['The three current units complete in about 1, 2 and 3 turns.', 'Theology completes near turn 87; The Wheel plus worker road work can support Meritocracy around turn 88, and Education is reachable near turn 108.', 'Troyes Library will not finish within this horizon. Older-city production menus do not currently expose Libraries, so National College timing is unresolved rather than assumed.'], 'firstActions': ['Complete the active military queues and inspect why Libraries are unavailable in Paris, Orleans and Lyon; queue them when legal while retaining Troyes Library.', 'Research Theology, then The Wheel, then Education unless a concrete threat or happiness crisis changes the order.', 'Renew luxury access before the Cotton/Sugar trade expires in 14 turns and preserve gold for emergencies; production conversions are unavailable in the current era.'], 'investment': 'Finish the active Lyon Archer, Paris Archer and Orleans Pikeman, then keep Troyes Library running; it has 8/75 production and about 34 turns remaining. This postpones wonders, new expansion and offensive recruitment; keep the 236 gold rather than buying a 200-gold Archer.', 'name': 'Infrastructure, happiness and science', 'objective': 'Convert France’s four-city population and production lead into a finish-capable science position while preserving flexibility.', 'relativeOutcome': 'This is the best current investment: it improves happiness, roads, universities and eventual National College access without committing to one terminal project. It will not finish a victory within 30 turns, and Greece may widen its technology lead, so it needs a disruption trigger if Greece actually starts Apollo.', 'risks': 'Growth arrives in Troyes in 1 turn, Orleans in 4, Lyon in 6 and Paris in 8; without Meritocracy or renewed luxuries, happiness can reach zero.     REVIEW 70 {'assessment': 'Prefer Plan 1. It secures the nearby southern site while preserving the National College, France’s strongest broad improvement. Military action is not yet credible, and deferring settlement risks losing territory without materially accelerating the College.', 'review': {'diplomacy': {'assessment': 'The Cotton-for-Sugar trade with Greece has 24 turns remaining, and prior border exchanges have kept the eastern relationship quiet. Greece already answered recent Corinth questions, so avoid repetitive contact; send a narrow movement notice only when the Settler commits.', 'initiatives': [{'approach': 'When the Settler commits, privately state that (-1,13) is within France’s southern core and is not a route toward Corinth; reaffirm notice before any eastern movement. Do not promise to abandon the site or reveal it is France’s only current expansion.', 'incentives': 'Greece benefits from trade and a quiet border, but may resist territorial implications. A reciprocal, non-binding signal is inexpensive and consistent with France’s existing promise to announce any eastern route change.', 'nextStep': 'Wait until the Settler’s route is chosen in about 3 turns, then send the concise notice.', 'objective': 'Prevent Greece from misreading France’s southern settlement as movement toward Corinth, reducing the chance of precautionary military spending while France completes the College.', 'plan': 1, 'players': ['Greece'], 'reconsiderWhen': 'Stop relying on the understanding if Greece contests the route, moves forces without notice, or demands a costly concession; switch to reconnaissance and defense.'}]}, 'horizonTurns': 18, 'outcomeAssessment': 'The prior choice improved population +4, production +14, science +10, culture +3, happiness +2, treasury +137, and added one Warrior from turns 61–71. Its key expectations are untested: the Settler and National College remain unfinished. France has 8 technologies versus Greece’s 11. Greece’s Apollo milestone is only an unmet requirement, not evidence that Apollo has started; no terminal project is observed.', 'plans': [{'expectedObservations': ['The Settler completes and the southern route remains uncontested within 3 turns.', 'The National College completes near turn 89 and raises displayed empire science from 28 to about 36.', 'France remains ahead in population and production while Greece’s technology and treasury lead is monitored.'], 'firstActions': ['Keep Civil Service research and the current queues.', 'Recheck the southern route and foreign units when the Settler completes; found only if safe and happiness remains positive.', 'Use Orleans’s Worker on a worked resource or useful connection.'], 'investment': 'Keep Paris on Settler for about 3 turns, Orleans on Worker for about 5, and Lyon on National College for about 18 turns. The College costs 215 production, has 40 stored at 10/turn, and will add +8 science and +1.2 culture. Founding consumes roughly 4 happiness from the current +5 buffer.', 'name': 'Finish settlement and National College', 'objective': 'Complete the Settler, found at (-1,13) if safe, and complete Lyon’s National College to retain a broad science-led position.', 'relativeOutcome': 'This compounds France’s current strengths and secures a defensible site with Cattle/Wheat potential. The site has no observed new luxury and overlaps existing ranges, so its near-term output is modest; however, losing it permanently is costly. Greece benefits from the peaceful window but France gains more from the College and extra city if no rival accelerates.', 'risks': 'A foreign Settler or army, poor route, or low site payoff can make founding inferior. The College improves catch-up but does not prove France beats Greece to a terminal victory.'}, {'expectedObservations': ['The College completes around turn 89 and provides its displayed science increase.', 'Happiness and existing-city growth remain safer, but another player may claim the southern site.', 'Greece’s technology lead either narrows after the College or continues widening.'], 'firstActions': ['Do not cancel the current Settler blindly; inspect the site and foreign movement on completion.', 'If deferring, compare Paris’s next production between defense and growth.', 'Keep the Settler mobile until the site is actually contested.'], 'investment': 'Finish the Settler in about 3 turns but hold it rather than found. Paris can then resume a native option; a Warrior takes about 4 turns and restores +6 food but costs 7.5 production while building. This risks losing (-1,13).', 'name': 'Hold the Settler and maximize the core', 'objective': 'Complete the College while avoiding the fourth city’s happiness and marginal-output costs if fresh reconnaissance makes the site unattractive.', 'relativeOutcome': 'Safer for happiness and existing-city efficiency, but it sacrifices territory and future production. It also leaves France with less frontier depth for any later intervention.', 'risks': 'The site may be unrecoverable once claimed. Prefer this only if contest, danger, or a clearly superior core investment appears.'}, {'expectedObservations': ['The map shows an Edinburgh Worker at (9,10), but also several defenders; France’s Scout at (8,9) has no hostile contact.', 'Any buildup is likely to trigger reinforcement by Greece or Edinburgh.', 'If no exposed civilian or short withdrawal route appears, development remains superior.'], 'firstActions': ['Keep scouting the eastern corridor and keep the Warrior at (-1,13) covering the Settler.', 'Do not declare war from the Edinburgh alert or visible units alone.', 'Escalate only after identifying a concrete objective and a withdrawal or peace condition.'], 'investment': 'Scout first. Current Warriors cannot upgrade because Iron Working and one Iron are missing; Archery is not researched. Corinth has defense 11 plus a Warrior, while Edinburgh has defense 15 with Warriors and Archers. Recruitment and travel would delay both settlement and the College.', 'name': 'Reconnaissance-led limited eastern pressure', 'objective': 'Look for an attainable pillage, Worker capture, or defensive diversion near Corinth or Edinburgh without attempting broad conquest.', 'relativeOutcome': 'A limited action could force rival spending, but it is not currently credible at acceptable cost. It would also conflict with France’s social assurance around Corinth, adding trust cost separate from war cost.', 'risks': 'Hex distance is not travel time and visible forces are incomplete. Abandon this plan if routes are long, reinforcements are present, or the objective cannot repay lost development.'}], 'preferredPlan': 1, 'reconsiderWhen': 'Change course if a foreign Settler or army contests (-1,13), happiness reaches 0 or less, the College is materially delayed, Greece’s lead accelerates after Civil Service, or an actual rival terminal project is observed rather than merely listed as a milestone.'}}

    """Inspect frozen player histories without game execution or provider calls."""
    
    import hashlib
    import json
    import sqlite3
    from pathlib import Path
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    REPO = ROOT.parents[1]
    BATCHES = ("all-luna-attempt-2-0", "luna-terra-attempt-1-0")
    
    
    def write(path, value):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    
    
    def database(path):
        db = sqlite3.connect(path.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True)
        db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        db.execute("BEGIN")
        return db
    
    
    def at_turn(db, heads, key, cutoff):
        version = dict(heads).get(key)
        while version is not None:
            row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM records WHERE key=? AND version=?", (key, version)).fetchone()
            assert row is not None
            body = json.loads(row["body"])
            if body.get("turn", 0) <= cutoff:
                return {"key": key, "version": version, "body": body}
            version = row["parent"]
        return None
    
    
    def scan():
        inventory = []
        for batch in BATCHES:
            for game in sorted((REPO / "benchmarks" / batch / "games").glob("g*")):
                raw = (game / "turn-recovery/current.json").read_bytes()
                recovery = json.loads(raw)
                canonical = json.dumps(recovery["host"], sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
                assert hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest() == recovery["hostSha256"]
                native = json.loads(recovery["host"]["gameJson"])
                cutoff = native["turns"] - 1
                out = ROOT / batch / game.name
                source = {
                    "source": str(game.relative_to(REPO)),
                    "completed_turn": cutoff,
                    "epoch": recovery["epoch"],
                    "recovery_id": recovery["id"],
                    "recovery_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                    "host_sha256": recovery["hostSha256"],
                    "game_sha256": hashlib.sha256(recovery["host"]["gameJson"].encode()).hexdigest(),
                    "players": {},
                }
                # Freeze the save for an independently inspectable boundary. All
                # candidate classifier evidence below is from the owning player.
                write(out / "game.json", native)
                for civ, ref in recovery["players"].items():
                    service = game / "agent-services" / civ
                    snapraw = (service / "turn-recovery" / f"{ref['id']}.json").read_bytes()
                    snapshot = json.loads(snapraw)
                    write(out / f"{civ}-boundary.json", snapshot)
                    source["players"][civ] = {"snapshot": ref, "file_sha256": hashlib.sha256(snapraw).hexdigest()}
                    db = database(service / "civilization/memory.sqlite3")
                    try:
                        overview = at_turn(db, snapshot["heads"], "observation:overview", cutoff)
                        tactics = at_turn(db, snapshot["heads"], "observation:tactics", cutoff)
                        economy = at_turn(db, snapshot["heads"], "observation:economy", cutoff)
                        write(out / f"{civ}-observations.json", {"overview": overview, "tactics": tactics, "economy": economy})
                        reviews = []
                        for value in snapshot["reviews"]:
                            if value["turn"] <= cutoff and value["status"] == "COMPLETED":
                                row = {k: value[k] for k in ("job", "turn", "status", "advice")}
                                if isinstance(row["advice"], str):
                                    row["advice"] = json.loads(row["advice"])
                                reviews.append(row)
                        write(out / f"{civ}-reviews.json", reviews)
                        if not overview:
                            continue
                        b = overview["body"]
                        economy_body = b.get("economy", {})
                        progress = b.get("recentProgress", {})
                        inventory.append({
                            "batch": batch, "game": game.name, "civilization": civ,
                            "completed_turn": cutoff, "observation_turn": b.get("turn"),
                            "overview_version": overview["version"],
                            "economy": {k: v for k, v in economy_body.items() if not isinstance(v, (dict, list))},
                            "cities": [{k: c.get(k) for k in ("name", "population", "constructionQueue", "constructionChoice", "constructionEstimates", "citizens")} for c in b.get("cities", [])],
                            "progress": {k: progress.get(k) for k in ("fromTurn", "toTurn", "happiness", "exploration", "repeatedCommands", "omitted")},
                            "review_turns": [v["turn"] for v in reviews],
                        })
                    finally:
                        db.close()
                write(out / "source.json", source)
        write(ROOT / "inventory.json", inventory)
        for row in inventory:
            print(row["batch"], row["game"], row["civilization"], row["completed_turn"], json.dumps(row["economy"]), "happiness", json.dumps(row["progress"]["happiness"]), "exploration", json.dumps(row["progress"]["exploration"]))
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        scan()

        import pathlib,sqlite3,json
        p=pathlib.Path('benchmarks/luna-terra-attempt-1-0/games/g0003/agent-services/Greece/civilization/memory.sqlite3')
        db=sqlite3.connect(p.resolve().as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True);db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row;db.execute('BEGIN')
        for row in db.execute("SELECT id,game_turn,status,snapshot FROM jobs WHERE purpose='gameplay' AND game_turn IN (99,100) ORDER BY game_turn,rowid"):
         print('\nJOB',row['id'],row['game_turn'],row['status'])
         for c in db.execute('SELECT rowid,name,arguments,result FROM calls WHERE job=? ORDER BY rowid',(row['id'],)):
          args=json.loads(c['arguments']); result=json.loads(c['result']) if c['result'] else None
          if c['name']=='player_command':
           if result: print(c['rowid'],c['name'],json.dumps(args), {k:result[k] for k in ('actionSummary','combat','dismissedNotifications') if result.get(k)})
          elif c['name'] in ('unit_details','map_region','memory_update','player_turn'):
           print(c['rowid'],c['name'],json.dumps(args))
           if c['name']=='unit_details':print('DETAILS',json.dumps(result)[:5000])
        PY

    """Checkpoint-aware frozen advisory inputs and outputs, never notebook authority."""
    
    import copy
    import re
    
    from sqlalchemy import select
    
    from civ_agent import memory_schema as tables
    from civ_agent.decisions_ledger import canonical, fingerprint
    from civ_agent.memory_records import public_record
    from civ_agent.memory_snapshots import dump_snapshot, load_snapshot
    from civ_agent.memory_store import RecordStore, expired_at, select_context
    
    
    def material_facts(view):
        """Exclude transport metadata, routine progress counters and stockpiles.
    
        These are eligibility signals, not alternate gameplay rules. The complete
        frozen context can still accompany a request once it is eligible.
        """
        economy = view.get("economy") or {}
        progress = view.get("recentProgress") or {}
        diplomacy = view.get("diplomacy", [])
        if isinstance(diplomacy, dict):
            diplomacy = diplomacy.get("knownCivilizations", [])
        return {
            "cities": [
                (
                    c.get("handle"),
                    c.get("name"),
                    c.get("constructionQueue"),
                    c.get("health", 100) < c.get("maxHealth", 100),
                    {k: v for k, v in (c.get("constructionChoice") or {}).items() if k != "turnsObserved"},
                )
                for c in view.get("cities", [])
            ],
            "units": [
                (u.get("handle"), u.get("name"), u.get("workerJob", (u.get("worker") or {}).get("currentJob")))
                for u in view.get("units", view.get("map", {}).get("units", []))
            ],
            "researchQueue": view.get("researchQueue"),
            "diplomacy": [{k: r.get(k) for k in ("civilizationId", "atWar", "defeated", "status")} for r in diplomacy],
            "economicPressure": {"unhappy": economy.get("happiness", 0) < 0, "deficit": economy.get("goldPerTurn", 0) < 0},
            "resources": [(r.get("name"), r.get("available", 0) > 0) for r in economy.get("resources", [])],
            "stalledProduction": [
                (c.get("city"), p.get("construction"))
                for c in progress.get("cities", [])
                for p in c.get("retainedProduction", [])
                if p.get("activeNow") and p.get("sameProductionObservedTurns", 0) >= 3
            ],
            "stalledOrders": [
                u.get("unit")
                for u in progress.get("units", [])
                if u.get("destination") and u.get("samePositionObservedTurns", 0) >= 3
            ],
            "hostiles": (view.get("tacticalReview") or {}).get("visibleHostiles", []),
        }
    
    
    def active(record, turn):
        return record["body"].get("state") == "active" and not expired_at(record, turn)
    
    
    def reference(key, record):
        return {"key": key, "version": record["version"], "record": public_record(key, record)}
    
    
    class AdvisoryStore:
        def __init__(self, memory):
            self.memory = memory
    
        def state(self):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                return self.memory._meta(db, "advisories", {})
    
        def save(self, **values):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                state = self.memory._meta(db, "advisories", {})
                state.update(copy.deepcopy(values))
                self.memory._set(db, "advisories", state)
    
        def freeze(self, job, topics, settings):
            """Current reachable sources only; classifier/notices never become news."""
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                self.memory._validate(db, job.id)
                snapshot = load_snapshot(db, db.scalar(select(tables.jobs.c.snapshot).where(tables.jobs.c.id == job.id)))
                records, turn = snapshot["records"], snapshot.get("gameTurn")
                objectives = [
                    reference(k, r) for k, r in records.items() if r["category"] == "strategy" and active(r, turn)
                ]
                words = set(re.findall(r"\w{3,}", canonical([sorted(topics), objectives]).casefold()))
                candidates = [(k, r) for k, r in records.items() if r["category"] in {"belief", "note"} and active(r, turn)]
                candidates.sort(
                    key=lambda item: (
                        -len(words & set(re.findall(r"\w{3,}", canonical(public_record(*item)).casefold()))),
                        -item[1]["body"].get("priority", 3),
                        item[0],
                    )
                )
                retrieval = [reference(k, r) for k, r in candidates[: settings.decisions_memory_candidate_limit]]
                state = self.memory._meta(db, "advisories", {})
                seen = state.get("seenSources", {})
                current = RecordStore(db).all(categories={"statement", "observation"})
                sources = []
                for key, record in current.items():
                    if seen.get(key) == record["version"] or key == "observation:native_advice":
                        continue
                    # Statements are retained verbatim. Facts use recorded material
                    # deltas/signals, never full review capture or a hidden engine read.
                    if record["category"] == "statement":
                        sources.append(reference(key, record))
                sources.sort(key=lambda s: (s["record"].get("turn", 0) or 0, s["key"]), reverse=True)
                sources = sources[: settings.decisions_preservation_candidate_limit]
                new_evidence = list(sources)
                overview = current.get("observation:overview")
                if overview:
                    facts = material_facts(overview["body"])
                    if fingerprint(facts) != state.get("seenFacts"):
                        new_evidence.append(
                            {
                                "key": "observation:overview",
                                "version": overview["version"],
                                "record": {"body": facts},
                                "projection": "Recorded material facts only",
                            }
                        )
                beliefs = [reference(k, r) for k, r in candidates if r["category"] == "belief"]
                # A changed ranking context is a selection need only if optional
                # candidates compete or include older entries omitted deterministically.
                selected, _ = select_context({**snapshot, "contextTopics": sorted(topics)}, self.memory.context_limit)
                retrieval_needed = any(r["key"] not in selected for r in retrieval)
                return {
                    "objectives": objectives,
                    "topics": sorted(topics),
                    "retrieval": retrieval if retrieval_needed else [],
                    "preservation": sources,
                    "newEvidence": new_evidence,
                    "beliefs": beliefs[: settings.decisions_belief_candidate_limit] if new_evidence else [],
                }
    
        def apply(self, job, evidence, result):
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                self.memory._validate(db, job.id)
                snapshot = load_snapshot(db, db.scalar(select(tables.jobs.c.snapshot).where(tables.jobs.c.id == job.id)))
                answers = {a["name"]: a for a in result.get("answers", [])}
                ranks = {}
                notices, preservation = [], []
                current = RecordStore(db).all()
                evidence_current = all(
                    current.get(s["key"], {}).get("version") == s["version"] for s in evidence.get("newEvidence", [])
                )
                for field in ("retrieval", "preservation", "beliefs"):
                    for index, source in enumerate(evidence.get(field, [])):
                        answer = answers.get(f"{field}:{index}")
                        record = current.get(source["key"])
                        if not answer or not record or record["version"] != source["version"]:
                            continue
                        if field == "retrieval" and active(record, snapshot.get("gameTurn")):
                            ranks[source["key"]] = answer["choice"]
                        elif field == "preservation" and answer["choice"] == "consider":
                            preservation.append(source)
                        elif (
                            field == "beliefs"
                            and evidence_current
                            and answer["choice"] == "reconsider"
                            and active(record, snapshot.get("gameTurn"))
                        ):
                            notices.append(
                                {
                                    "belief": source,
                                    "sources": evidence.get("newEvidence", []),
                                    "confidence": answer["confidence"],
                                    "advisoryOnly": True,
                                }
                            )
                snapshot["advisories"] = {
                    "preservationCandidates": preservation,
                    "beliefNotices": notices,
                    "requestId": result.get("requestId"),
                }
                snapshot["advisoryRanking"] = ranks
                db.execute(
                    tables.jobs.update().where(tables.jobs.c.id == job.id).values(snapshot=dump_snapshot(db, snapshot))
                )
                return snapshot["advisories"], ranks
    
        def review_input(self, turn, settings):
            """Read previously recorded signals; never open a player/review connection."""
            with self.memory.transaction() as db:
                last = db.scalar(
                    select(tables.reviews.c.turn)
                    .where(tables.reviews.c.status == "COMPLETED")
                    .order_by(tables.reviews.c.turn.desc())
                    .limit(1)
                )
                state = self.memory._meta(db, "advisories", {})
                if last is None or turn - last < settings.early_review_min_gap_turns:
                    return None
                early = state.get("lastEarlyTurn")
                if early is not None and turn - early < settings.early_review_min_gap_between_early_turns:
                    return None
                records = RecordStore(db).all(categories={"strategy", "observation", "statement"})
                overview = records.get("observation:overview")
                if overview is None:
                    return None
                facts = material_facts(overview["body"])
                # A stable material signature never creates a repeated paid call.
                objectives = [
                    reference(k, r) for k, r in records.items() if r["category"] == "strategy" and active(r, turn)
                ]
                words = set(re.findall(r"\w{4,}", canonical(objectives).casefold()))

    # Gameplay feedback improvements
    
    Implementation following the October 10 Luna gameplay audit. Factual history and
    context assembly use Python/Kotlin. The existing player model interprets evidence
    and chooses actions; no additional summarizing model or automatic adjudication is
    introduced.
    
    1. Preserve a bounded, checkpointed history of permitted observations and combine
       it with confirmed receipts. Show repeated orders alongside observed unit,
       exploration and construction progress, including actions without plan links.
    2. Compare continuing output, building then selecting an available conversion, and
       purchasing then selecting that conversion. Use native previews, expose queue
       operations separately, and retain end-of-horizon assets and incomplete progress.
    3. Bring changed facts into plan reviews: observed unhappiness, food, imports,
       access, resource ownership and interrupted development. Preview empire-wide
       happiness and food effects without projecting future population or citizen choices.
    4. Supply recent conversation excerpts grouped by exact audience, with source IDs
       and dates, plus existing player-authored notes. Clarify victory milestones as
       requirements; the player interprets replies, commitments and strategic relevance.
    5. Group explicitly linked investment receipts with observed results and current
       upkeep. Keep unlinked expenditure visible separately. Invite reconsideration
       when spending or renewing peace; never require aggression or enforce promises.
    
    Validation: native preview equivalence and non-mutation, host integration,
    history replay/restart/rewind, audience separation, pending-versus-enacted trades,
    and regressions based on the audited stalled Scout, delayed Library, unhappy
    economy and upgrades during peace. Behavioral gains require subsequent controlled
    model runs; passing software tests alone does not establish stronger play.
    
    Validated October 11, 2026: the full host build passed (162 tests), the native
    `BuildingYieldPreviewTest` suite passed (9 tests), and the Python suite passed
    (1,333 tests and 76 subtests; 10 optional environment-dependent tests skipped).
    Ruff formatting/lint, Pyrefly, and both repositories' whitespace checks passed.
    A read-only replay of the original audit's player observations recovered France's
    17 repeated Scout orders with zero exploration, Persia's unchanged Library work,
    Inca's 13 observed unhappy turns, China's 680-gold upgrades, and Arabia's missing
    Settler. See the retained [replay artifacts](../../build/luna-feedback-replay-20261011/summary.json).
    
    The additional operator-requested policy blocks Gold, Science and Culture
    production for API-controlled players before the selected ruleset's final era
    (Future era in the bundled Vanilla rules). Other native prerequisites still apply
    after that era. The host removes blocked saved/automated queue entries while
    preserving ordinary construction work, exposes the restriction in
    `productionPolicy`, rejects explicit queue requests, and excludes blocked
    conversions from investment alternatives. Native AI control is unchanged.
    
    `recentProgress` retains a 20-turn window of permitted samples (up to 21 turn observations) in the existing
    checkpoint metadata. The overview presents context as of its first delivery that
    turn, keeping command updates concise; receipts and live state carry subsequent
    changes. Strategic reviews recompute progress from the latest observation.
    Reports distinguish repeated accepted commands, sampled
    positions, empire exploration, retained construction production, unhappy
    observations, imports, border agreements and newly observed resource ownership.
    `decisionFeedback` adds confirmed receipt spending and matching current units to
    explicitly linked choices. The history also reports unlinked spending separately;
    it does not infer a plan association from prose or label missing units destroyed.
    
    `chat_read.conversationContext` retrieves up to six exact-audience threads with up
    to six messages each within a 12,000-character message budget, including confirmed sends awaiting their event echo. Sources
    are delivered as evidence and replay/rewind follows the existing journal. Existing
    private notes remain the player's place for unanswered questions and follow-up
    conditions. No model is asked to summarize conversations automatically.

    """Freeze concrete player-visible examples; keep later outcomes separate."""
    
    import collections
    import hashlib
    import json
    
    from review_saved_games import REPO, ROOT, database, write
    
    
    def open_player(batch, game, civ):
        service = REPO / "benchmarks" / batch / "games" / game / "agent-services" / civ
        boundary = ROOT / batch / game / f"{civ}-boundary.json"
        if boundary.exists():
            snap = json.loads(boundary.read_text())
        else:
            recovery = json.loads((service.parents[1] / "turn-recovery/current.json").read_text())
            ref = recovery["players"][civ]
            raw = (service / "turn-recovery" / f"{ref['id']}.json").read_bytes()
            snap = json.loads(raw)
            write(ROOT / "historical" / f"{game}-{civ}-boundary.json", snap)
            write(ROOT / "historical" / f"{game}-{civ}-source.json", {
                "batch": batch, "game": game, "civilization": civ,
                "recovery_id": recovery["id"], "player_snapshot": ref,
                "snapshot_file_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            })
        return database(service / "civilization/memory.sqlite3"), snap
    
    
    def job_at(db, snapshot, turn):
        valid = {j["id"] for j in snapshot["jobs"] if j["status"] == "COMPLETED"}
        jobs = [dict(j) for j in db.execute(
            "SELECT id,game_turn,snapshot FROM jobs WHERE purpose='gameplay' AND game_turn=? AND status='COMPLETED' ORDER BY rowid",
            (turn,),
        ) if j["id"] in valid]
        assert len(jobs) == 1, (turn, len(jobs))
        job = jobs[0]
        job["snapshot"] = json.loads(job["snapshot"])
        return job
    
    
    def calls_for(db, job):
        result = []
        for row in db.execute("SELECT rowid,name,arguments,result FROM calls WHERE job=? ORDER BY rowid", (job["id"],)):
            result.append({
                "rowid": row["rowid"], "name": row["name"],
                "arguments": json.loads(row["arguments"]),
                "result": json.loads(row["result"]) if row["result"] else None,
            })
        return result
    
    
    def overview(db, job):
        version = job["snapshot"]["delivered"]["observation:overview"]
        body = json.loads(db.execute(
            "SELECT body FROM records WHERE key='observation:overview' AND version=?", (version,),
        ).fetchone()[0])
        return {"key": "observation:overview", "version": version, "body": body}
    
    
    def raid():
        db, snap = open_player("luna-terra-attempt-1-0", "g0003", "Greece")
        try:
            job = job_at(db, snap, 99)
            calls = calls_for(db, job)
            selected = {c["rowid"]: c for c in calls if c["rowid"] in (2206, 2214, 2218, 2219, 2220, 2221, 2222, 2229)}
            assert len(selected) == 8
            plan = next(d for d in selected[2214]["arguments"]["changes"][0]["content"]["decisions"] if d["id"] == "arabian_worker_raid_99")
            entities = {n: selected[n]["result"]["data"]["entity"] for n in (2218, 2220, 2221)}
            attack = next(a for a in entities[2218]["combat"]["attacks"] if a["attackFrom"] == {"x": 0, "y": -8} and a["destination"] == {"x": 0, "y": -9})
            region = selected[2206]["result"]["data"]
            visible = [t for t in region["tiles"] if t.get("visible") and (t.get("cityName") or t.get("units"))]
            next_calls = calls_for(db, job_at(db, snap, 100))
            notices = [n for c in next_calls for n in (c["result"] or {}).get("dismissedNotifications", []) if "Scout" in n.get("text", "")]
            write(ROOT / "cases/raid-raw-calls.json", selected)
            case = {
                "id": "greece-raid-withdrawal", "source": "luna-terra-attempt-1-0/g0003/Greece",
                "turn": 99, "job": job["id"],
                "input": {
                    "savedDecision": plan, "visibleRegion": visible, "regionDefaults": region.get("tileDefaults"),
                    "nativeAttackPreview": attack,
                    "captureReceipt": {k: selected[2219]["result"].get(k) for k in ("actionSummary", "combat", "turn")},
                    "afterCapture": [{"handle": e["handle"], "name": e["name"], "position": e["position"], "movement": e["movement"], "moves": e.get("moves", [])} for e in (entities[2220], entities[2221])],
                    "escortOrder": selected[2222]["arguments"],
                    "proposedCommand": selected[2229]["arguments"],
                    "sourceCallRowids": sorted(n for n in selected if n != 2229),
                },
                "proposedQuestion": "Before ending the turn, does the evidence establish the saved condition of a safe capture and withdrawal, or should that condition be reviewed?",
                "choices": ["condition_supported", "review_condition", "insufficient_evidence"],
                "analystLabel": "review_condition",
                "heldOutOutcome": {"turn": 100, "ownNotifications": notices},
                "limitation": "This supports checking an unverified retreat assumption. It does not prove the Worker-for-Scout exchange was strategically bad or predict enemy damage.",
            }
            assert all(n < 2229 for n in case["input"]["sourceCallRowids"])
            write(ROOT / "cases/raid.json", case)
        finally:
            db.close()
    
    
    def production_drift():
        db, snap = open_player("all-luna-attempt-2-0", "g0001", "France")
        try:
            observations = {}
            jobs = {}
            for turn in (106, 107, 110, 111):
                jobs[turn] = job_at(db, snap, turn)
                observations[turn] = overview(db, jobs[turn])
            cities = {t: next(c for c in o["body"]["cities"] if c["name"] == "Troyes") for t, o in observations.items()}
            advice = jobs[107]["snapshot"]["strategicAdvice"]
            assert advice["asOfTurn"] == 100
            write(ROOT / "cases/production-drift-observations.json", observations)
            corrections = [c for c in calls_for(db, jobs[111]) if c["name"] == "player_command" and c["arguments"].get("target") == "city4"]
            case = {
                "id": "troyes-university-timing", "source": "all-luna-attempt-2-0/g0001/France",
                "turn": 107, "job": jobs[107]["id"],
                "input": {
                    "deliveredStrategyAsOfTurn": 100,
                    "deliveredPlan": advice["review"]["plans"][0],
                    "previous": {"turn": 106, "version": observations[106]["version"], "city": cities[106]},
                    "current": {"turn": 107, "version": observations[107]["version"], "city": cities[107]},
                },
                "proposedQuestion": "Do the changed native construction estimates materially undermine the delivered plan's near-term University timing?",
                "choices": ["review_timing", "within_plan", "insufficient_evidence"],
                "analystLabel": "review_timing",
                "heldOutOutcome": {
                    "normalReviewTurn": 110,
                    "normalReview": next(r for r in snap["reviews"] if r["turn"] == 110)["advice"],
                    "correctionTurn": 111, "calls": corrections,
                    "correctedCity": cities[111],
                },
                "limitation": "A sooner alert could have invited a tradeoff review. Growth versus production has no universally correct answer, and no causal gain was measured.",
            }
            assert cities[106]["constructionEstimates"]["University"]["production"]["turnsIfStartedNow"] == 24
            assert cities[107]["constructionEstimates"]["University"]["production"]["turnsIfStartedNow"] == 67
            write(ROOT / "cases/production-drift.json", case)
        finally:
            db.close()
    
    
    def outcome_control():
        db, snap = open_player("luna-terra-attempt-1-0", "g0001", "Inca")
        try:
            job = job_at(db, snap, 100)
            attack = next(c for c in calls_for(db, job) if c["name"] == "player_command" and c["arguments"].get("kind") == "CITY_ATTACK")
            result = attack["result"]
            assert result["combat"]["defenderHealth"] == 3
            assert result["combat"]["defenderDestroyed"] is False
            write(ROOT / "cases/outcome-control.json", {
                "id": "inca-unfinished-kill", "source": "luna-terra-attempt-1-0/g0001/Inca",
                "turn": 100, "job": job["id"],
                "input": {"arguments": attack["arguments"], "receipt": {k: result.get(k) for k in ("actionSummary", "combat", "turn")}},
                "analystLabel": "deterministic_outcome_check",
                "finding": "The intended kill was not achieved. Structured combat fields already answer this without paid semantic classification.",
                "callRowid": attack["rowid"],
            })
        finally:
            db.close()
    
    
    def reserve_control():
        db, snap = open_player("all-luna-attempt-2-0", "g0004", "China")
        try:
            job = job_at(db, snap, 100)
            view = overview(db, job)
            advice = job["snapshot"]["strategicAdvice"]
            review100 = next(r for r in snap["reviews"] if r["turn"] == 100)
            later = json.loads(review100["advice"])
            write(ROOT / "cases/reserve-control.json", {
                "id": "china-large-reserve", "source": "all-luna-attempt-2-0/g0004/China", "turn": 100,
                "input": {
                    "economy": view["body"]["economy"],
                    "cityQueues": [{k: c[k] for k in ("name", "population", "constructionQueue")} for c in view["body"]["cities"]],
                    "deliveredStrategyAsOfTurn": advice["asOfTurn"],
                    "deliveredPlans": advice["review"]["plans"],
                },
                "analystLabel": "no_automatic_spend_conclusion",
                "heldOutLaterReview": {"turn": 100, "plans": later["review"]["plans"]},
                "finding": "A large reserve can finance priced contingencies. A comparison may be useful, but treasury size alone does not establish a mistake or justify an automatic spend recommendation.",
            })
        finally:
            db.close()
    
    
    def scouting_control():
        db, snap = open_player("all-luna-attempt-1-1", "g0002", "China")
        try:
            accepted = []
            samples = []
            corrections = []
            for turn in range(238, 258):
                job = job_at(db, snap, turn)
                view = overview(db, job)
                body = view["body"]
                samples.append({
                    "turn": turn, "version": view["version"], "exploration": body.get("exploration"),
                    "mapSummary": body.get("mapSummary"),
                    "scouts": [u for u in body.get("units", []) if u.get("handle") in ("unit27", "unit28")],
                })
                for c in calls_for(db, job):
                    a, r = c["arguments"], c["result"] or {}
                    if c["name"] != "player_command" or a.get("target") not in ("unit27", "unit28"):
                        continue
                    if a.get("selection") == "EXPLORE" and r.get("actionSummary"):
                        accepted.append({"turn": turn, "rowid": c["rowid"], "arguments": a, "actionSummary": r["actionSummary"]})
                    elif a.get("kind") in ("MOVE_UNIT", "SET_UNIT_DESTINATION") and r.get("actionSummary"):
                        corrections.append({"turn": turn, "rowid": c["rowid"], "arguments": a, "receipt": {k: r.get(k) for k in ("actionSummary", "movement", "exploration")}})
            counts = collections.Counter(c["arguments"]["target"] for c in accepted)
            assert counts == {"unit27": 18, "unit28": 18}, counts
            write(ROOT / "cases/scouting-control.json", {
                "id": "china-repeated-scouting", "source": "all-luna-attempt-1-1/g0002/China",
                "turns": [238, 257], "counts": dict(counts),
                "acceptedOrders": accepted, "permittedObservations": samples, "laterCorrections": corrections,
                "analystLabel": "deterministic_stall_detection_first",
                "finding": "Repeated accepted orders and negligible observed exploration can be detected from factual history. Semantic triage may judge relevance to a saved reconnaissance objective, but is unnecessary for detecting the loop.",
            })
        finally:
            db.close()
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        for function in (raid, production_drift, outcome_control, reserve_control, scouting_control):
            function()
            print(function.__name__, "verified")
