                    self.history is not None
                    and not replayed
                    and name == "player_command"
                    and outcome == "success"
                    and result.get("kind") == arguments.get("kind")
                    and isinstance(result.get("kind"), str)
                ):
                    kind = result["kind"]
                    description = kind.replace("_", " ").capitalize() + " confirmed."
                    actions = (job.observation or {}).get("turnReview", {}).get("actions", [])
                    if kind != "END_TURN" and actions and actions[-1].get("kind") == kind:
                        description = actions[-1].get("description") or description
                    await self.io.call(self.history.action, job.id, call_id, kind, description)
                ended = result.get("stateUpdate", {}).get("kind") == "turn_ended"
                if ended:
                    job.gameplay_fenced = True
                if name == "native_advice":
                    # Advice explicitly names its observation epoch/revision. These
                    # are evidence, not authority to bypass command validation.
                    return result
                return public_result(result)
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                self.forget_observation(job)
                await self.sync_failure()
                raise
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, SQLAlchemyError):
                outcome = "error"
                # A memory batch may have durably failed before its export/response
                # failed too. Its terminal stop must still reach the lifecycle owner.
                await self.sync_failure()
                raise
            finally:
                if accounting and counted:
                    await self.io.call(accounting.end_call, counted, outcome, replayed)
                if ended:
                    # The native receipt, tool response and accounting are durable.
                    # Fence further calls before notifying the lifecycle controller.
                    if job.handoff_at is None:
                        job.handoff_at = time.monotonic()
                    job.gameplay_ended.set()
    
        async def _call_once(
            self, job: JobAccess, name: str, arguments: JsonObject, call_id: str, *, startup: bool = False
        ) -> tuple[JsonObject, bool]:
            self.check(job, ended_allowed=True)
            if not isinstance(name, str) or not isinstance(arguments, dict):
                raise ValueError("INVALID_ARGUMENT")
            if job.review_inputs is not None:
                return public_result(frozen_read(job.review_inputs, name, arguments)), False
            async with job.lock:
                self.check(job, ended_allowed=True)
                previous = await self.io.call(self.memory.call, job.id, call_id, name, arguments)
                if previous is not None:
                    return previous, True
                # The action receipt may be durable even if a barrier interrupted
                # saving the MCP response. Replay it without needing a new observation.
                receipt = await self.io.call(self.memory.call_receipt, job.id, call_id)
                self.check(
                    job,
                    ended_allowed=(
                        receipt is not None and name == "player_command" and arguments.get("kind") == "END_TURN"
                    ),
                )
                advice_revision = (job.observation or {}).get("revision")
                if receipt is not None:
                    result = copy.deepcopy(receipt)
                else:
                    result = await self._call(job, name, arguments, call_id, startup=startup)
                result = await self.settle_gameplay(job, name, result)
                if self.native_advice_enabled:
                    if name == "native_advice":
                        await self.io.call(experiment_metrics.exposure, self.memory, job, call_id, result, startup)
                    elif name == "player_command":
                        await self.io.call(
                            experiment_metrics.action_match, self.memory, job, call_id, arguments, result, advice_revision
                        )
                result = await self.update_after_action(job, name, arguments, call_id, result)
                result = await self.io.call(self.memory.call, job.id, call_id, name, arguments, result)
                assert result is not None
                return result, receipt is not None
    
        @staticmethod
        def forget_observation(job: JobAccess) -> None:
            job.pending_invalidated.extend(query for query in job.details_read if query not in job.pending_invalidated)
            job.observation = None
            job.delivered_overview = None
            job.detail_revision = None
            job.details_read.clear()
            job.trades.clear()
    
        async def deliver_turn(
            self,
            job: JobAccess,
            value: JsonObject,
            name: str,
            arguments: JsonObject,
                routing_ids=recent.get("routingEventIds", []) if job.purpose == "communication" else [],
            )
            delivered = {event["body"]["message"] for event in events if event["kind"] == "message"}
            outgoing = await self.io.call(self.memory.outgoing_messages, limit=20, echo_cursor=recent["cursor"])
            messages = [
                row["message"] for row in outgoing if row["message"]["message"] not in delivered | job.seen_messages
            ]
            job.seen_messages.update(delivered)
            job.seen_messages.update(message["message"] for message in messages)
            context = await self.io.call(
                self.memory.conversation_context, [e["body"] for e in events if e["kind"] == "message"] + messages
            )
            await self.io.call(self.memory.refresh_memory, job.id, context.pop("_evidenceKeys"))
            job.seen_messages.update(m["message"] for thread in context["threads"] for m in thread["messages"])
            return public_result(
                self.register_external_read(
                    job,
                    "chat_read",
                    arguments,
                    {
                        **social,
                        "messages": events,
                        "conversationContext": context,
                        **({"deliveries": await self.routing.statuses()} if self.routing is not None else {}),
                        **({"recentSentMessages": messages} if messages else {}),
                    },
                )
            )
    
        async def _call(
            self, job: JobAccess, name: str, arguments: JsonObject, call_id: str, *, startup: bool = False
        ) -> JsonObject:
            self.check(job)
            arguments = copy.deepcopy(arguments)
            if not job.verified:
                identity = await job.connection.tool("player_communication", {"op": "state", "epoch": job.epoch})
                if identity.get("civilization") != self.memory.civilization or identity.get("epoch") != job.epoch:
                    raise StateConflict("PLAYER_CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH")
                job.verified = True
            if BOOKKEEPING & arguments.keys():
                raise ValueError("Supply gameplay choices only; the service manages request bookkeeping.")
            if name == "memory_update":
                try:
                    arguments = MemoryUpdate.model_validate(arguments).model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
                except ValidationError as error:
                    return memory_argument_error(arguments, error)
            elif name in TOOL_MODELS:
                model = tool_model(name, job.purpose)
                try:
                    arguments = model.model_validate(arguments).model_dump(by_alias=True, exclude_unset=True)
                except ValidationError as error:
                    return argument_error(model, arguments, error)
            if name == "player_command":
                try:
                    arguments = command_arguments(arguments)
                except ValidationError as error:
                    return command_error(arguments, error)
            intent = arguments.pop("intent", None)
            if intent is not None:
                intent = validate(Intent, intent).model_dump()
            initiative_decisions = arguments.pop("initiativeDecisions", [])
            delivery = "auto"
            if name == "native_advice":
                if not self.native_advice_enabled or job.purpose != "gameplay":
                    raise StateConflict("NATIVE_ADVICE_DISABLED")
                if job.observation is None:
                    return self.reobserve_after_negotiation("Read player_turn before native_advice.")
                try:
                    async with asyncio.timeout(5):
                        value = await job.connection.tool(
                            "native_advice", {**arguments, "epoch": job.epoch, "revision": job.observation["revision"]}
                        )
                except (TimeoutError, OSError, ValueError, aiohttp.ClientError):
                    value = {
                        "available": False,
                        "epoch": job.epoch,
                        "revision": job.observation["revision"],
                        "recommendations": [],
                        "limitations": ["Native advice unavailable; continue ordinary gameplay."],
                    }
                self.check(job)
                if startup:
                    rows = value.get("recommendations", [])
                    if not isinstance(rows, list):
                        rows = []
                    value = {**value, "recommendations": rows[:8], "remainingRecommendations": max(0, len(rows) - 8)}
                await self.io.call(self.memory.observe, "native_advice", value, job.id)
                return value
            if name == "chat_delivery":
                if self.routing is None:
                    raise StateConflict("DIPLOMACY_ROUTING_DISABLED")
                return await self.routing.control(job, arguments)
            if name == "history_read":
                return public_result(
                    await self.io.call(self.memory.history, arguments["turn"], arguments.get("offset", 0), job=job.id)
                )
            self.check(job)
            if name in DETAIL_MODELS:
                if job.observation is None:
                    return self.reobserve_after_negotiation("Read player_turn before requesting details.")
                query = DetailQuery.model_validate({"tool": name, "arguments": arguments})

    class AdvisoryHost(StartupHost):
        def __init__(self):
            self.record = {"epoch": "g1", "gameTurn": 0}
            super().__init__(SimpleNamespace(service=SimpleNamespace(active_id="job", records={"job": self.record})))
            self.captures = []
            self.available = True
    
        async def tool(self, name, args):
            if name == "native_advice":
                self.captures.append(copy.deepcopy(args))
                return {
                    "epoch": args["epoch"],
                    "revision": args["revision"],
                    "turn": self.record["gameTurn"],
                    "available": self.available,
                    "recommendations": [
                        {
                            "id": f"native-{args['revision']}-{i}",
                            "category": "Construction",
                            "subject": "city1",
                            "explanation": "Original native explanation",
                            "command": {
                                "tool": "player_command",
                                "arguments": {"kind": "QUEUE_CONSTRUCTION", "target": "city1", "selection": name},
                            },
                            "costs": {"production": 40},
                            "prerequisites": ["Agriculture"],
                            "conflicts": ["city1"],
                        }
                        for i, name in enumerate(["Market", "Granary"] * 5)
                    ],
                    "limitations": ["No simulated discoveries."],
                }
            return await super().tool(name, args)
    
    
    class Classifier:
        def __init__(self, settings):
            self.settings, self.calls, self.mode = settings, [], "success"
    
        async def batch(self, evidence, *, timeout):
            self.calls.append(copy.deepcopy(evidence))
            if self.mode == "timeout":
                raise TimeoutError()
            if self.mode == "malformed":
                return {"requestId": request_id(evidence), "answers": "not an answer list"}
            body = request_body(evidence, self.settings)
            answers = []
            values = {"retrieval": "high", "preservation": "consider", "beliefs": "reconsider", "early_review": "review"}
            for q in body["questions"]:
                prefix = q["name"].split(":")[0]
                answer = {
                    "type": "choice",
                    "name": q["name"],
                    "choice": values.get(prefix, q["choices"][0]["value"]),
                    "confidence": 0.99,
                }
                if self.mode == "low":
                    answer["confidence"] = 0.1
                elif self.mode == "refusal":
                    answer = {"name": q["name"], "type": "refusal"}
                elif self.mode == "unknown":
                    answer["choice"] = "invented-choice"
                answers.append(answer)
            return {"answers": answers, "requestId": request_id(evidence), "usage": {"input_tokens": 100}}
    
    
    @asynccontextmanager
    async def setup(tmp_path, *, native_enabled=True, **options):
        settings = DecisionsSettings(decisions_enabled=True, **options)
        memory = CivilizationState(tmp_path / "memory", "Rome", settings.memory_context_chars)
        io = ServiceIO()
        gateway = ProposalGateway(memory, io, tmp_path / "workspace")
        gateway.native_advice_enabled = native_enabled
        classifier = Classifier(settings)
        gateway.advisories = AdvisoryRuntime(gateway, classifier, settings)
        host = AdvisoryHost()
        memory.bind("g1")
        try:
            yield memory, gateway, host, classifier
        finally:
            await io.close()
            memory.engine.dispose()
    
    
    def test_defaults_validation_retired_flags_and_service_container_arguments(tmp_path, capsys):
        config_file = tmp_path / "game.toml"
        config_file.write_text("[agents]\ndecisions_enabled = true\nadditional_decisions_budget_usd = 0.02\n")
        config = load_config(config_file).resolved()
        assert decisions_values(GameConfig().agents) == DecisionsSettings().model_dump()
        settings = config.settings(config.agent_players[0])
        arguments = ["Rome"]
        for key, value in settings.items():
            if isinstance(value, bool):
                if value:
                    arguments.append("--" + key.replace("_", "-"))
            else:
                arguments.extend(["--" + key.replace("_", "-"), str(value)])
        assert decisions_values(agent_server.parser().parse_args(arguments)) == decisions_values(config.agents)
        overridden = game.resolve_options(
            game.parser().parse_args(
                ["--additional-decisions-budget-usd", "0", "--decisions-enabled", "--memory-context-chars", "4000"]
            )
        )
        assert overridden.agents.decisions_enabled and overridden.agents.memory_context_chars == 4000
        assert overridden.agents.additional_decisions_budget_usd == 0
        for value in (-1, float("nan"), float("inf")):
            with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
                GameConfig(agents={"additional_decisions_budget_usd": value})
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="retired"):
            GameConfig(agents={"diplomacy_routing_enabled": False})
        for parser, args in ((game.parser(), []), (agent_server.parser(), ["Rome"])):
            with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
                parser.parse_args([*args, "--diplomacy-routing-enabled"])
            assert "retired" in capsys.readouterr().err
        for retired in ("decisions_native_candidate_limit", "decisions_gameplay_group_limit"):
            with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
                GameConfig(agents={retired: 4})

    def test_native_suggestions_are_delivered_directly_without_paid_gameplay_classification(tmp_path):
        async def run():
            async with setup(tmp_path) as (memory, gateway, host, classifier):
                job = await gateway.open("job", "gameplay", "g1", host, {}, 0)
                prepared = await prepare_startup(gateway, job)
                advice = prepared["reads"]["native_advice"]

                assert "native_advice" in catalogue and "gameplay_advice" not in catalogue
                assert "gameplay_advice" not in prepared["reads"]
                assert classifier.calls == []
                records = stored_records(memory)
                assert "observation:native_advice" in records
                exposure = [r for r in records.values() if r["category"] == "guidance"]
                assert len(exposure) == 1 and len(exposure[0]["body"]["recommendations"]) == 8
                prompt = startup_prompt(prepared, "gameplay", "Play").user
                assert "Original native explanation" in prompt
                assert (await prepare_startup(gateway, job))["reads"]["native_advice"] == advice
                # Choosing a legal alternative requires only the normal native inspections.
                await gateway.call(job, "city_details", {"target": "city1"}, "inspect")
                result = await gateway.call(
                    job,
                    "player_command",
                    {"kind": "QUEUE_CONSTRUCTION", "target": "city1", "selection": "Warrior"},
                    "alternative",
                )
                assert result["kind"] == "QUEUE_CONSTRUCTION" and host.executed[0]["selection"] == "Warrior"
                fresh = await gateway.call(job, "native_advice", {}, "refresh")
                assert fresh["revision"] == host.revision and len(fresh["recommendations"]) == 10
                assert classifier.calls == []  # Actions and native reads cannot initiate paid work.
    
        asyncio.run(run())

    """Prepare model startup through the same permitted gateway reads as explicit calls."""
    
    import hashlib
    import json
    from dataclasses import dataclass

    CORE_TOOLS = {
        "gameplay": (
            "player_turn",
            "player_command",
            "unit_details",
            "movement_preview",
            "construction_details",
            "map_region",
            "chat_send",
        ),
        "communication": ("chat_read", "chat_send", "memory_update"),
    }
    STARTUP_CALL_PREFIX = "startup:"
    MAX_PREPARED_UNIT_DETAILS = 6
    MAX_PREPARED_CONSTRUCTION_DETAILS = 2
    
    
    def encoded(value: object) -> str:
        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
    
    
    def core_definitions(catalogue: list[JsonObject], purpose: str) -> list[JsonObject]:
        by_name = {tool["name"]: tool for tool in catalogue}
        return tool_definitions([by_name[name] for name in CORE_TOOLS[purpose] if name in by_name])
    
    
    def tool_definitions(catalogue: list[JsonObject]) -> list[JsonObject]:
        """Use current gateway schemas, without output schemas or duplicate MCP metadata."""
        return [
            {
                "name": "mcp__civ__" + tool["name"],
                "description": tool.get("description", ""),
                "inputSchema": tool["inputSchema"],
            }
            for tool in catalogue
        ]
    
    
    def memory_topics(reads: JsonObject, advice: JsonObject | None = None) -> set[str]:
        """Match delivered subjects and proposed contacts, never infer topics from prose."""
        view, social = reads.get("player_turn", {}), reads.get("chat_read", {})
        topics: set[str] = set()
    
        def add(*values):
            topics.update(value for value in values if isinstance(value, str) and value)
    
        for entity in view.get("cities", []) + view.get("units", []):
            add(entity.get("handle"), entity.get("name"), entity.get("workerJob"))
            add(*entity.get("constructionQueue", []))
        for city in view.get("cities", []):
            if city.get("foodPerTurn") is not None and city["foodPerTurn"] <= 0:
                add("growth")
            if city.get("health") is not None and city.get("maxHealth") is not None and city["health"] < city["maxHealth"]:
                add("defense")
        add(*view.get("researchQueue", []))
        context = social.get("context") or {}
        for relation in view.get("diplomacy", []) + view.get("cityStates", []) + context.get("knownCivilizations", []):
            if relation.get("atWar"):
                add("war", "defense", relation.get("civilizationId"), relation.get("civilizationName"))
        for threat in (view.get("tacticalReview") or {}).get("visibleHostiles", []):
            add("defense", threat.get("civilization"))
        for force in (view.get("militaryReadiness") or {}).get("visibleBorderForces", []):
            add(force.get("civilization"))
        settlement = view.get("settlement") or {}
        if settlement.get("settlers") or (view.get("tacticalReview") or {}).get("citiesProducingSettlers"):
            add("expansion")
        economy = view.get("economy") or context.get("economy") or {}
        if economy.get("happiness", 0) < 0 or economy.get("goldPerTurn", 0) < 0:
            add("economy")
        for resource in economy.get("resources", []):
            if any(resource.get(field, 0) > 0 for field in ("available", "used", "imported", "exported")):
                add(resource.get("name"))
        changes = view.get("changesSincePreviousTurn") or {}
        add(*changes.get("resourcesNoLongerAvailable", []))
        for entity in changes.get("unitsNoLongerOwned", []) + changes.get("citiesNoLongerOwned", []):
            add(entity.get("handle"), entity.get("name"))
        for record in social.get("offers", []) + social.get("trades", []) + social.get("agreements", []):
            add(record.get("proposalId"), record.get("agreement"), record.get("partner"), record.get("author"))
            add(*record.get("participants", []))
        events = social.get("messages", []) + [
            {"body": message}
            for thread in (social.get("conversationContext") or {}).get("threads", [])
            for message in thread["messages"]
        ]
        for event in events:
            record = event.get("body", {})
            add(record.get("author"), record.get("from"), record.get("to"), record.get("partner"))
            add(*record.get("participants", []))
        if advice:
            for initiative in advice["review"]["diplomacy"]["initiatives"]:
                add(*initiative["players"])
        return topics
    
    
    def decision_queries(view: JsonObject) -> list[tuple[str, JsonObject]]:
        """Select bounded, action-enabling local details advertised by the overview."""
        unit_sections: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for unit in view.get("units", []):
            inspections = unit.get("inspections") or {}
            if not isinstance(inspections, dict):
                continue
            for inspection in inspections.values():
                if not isinstance(inspection, dict) or inspection.get("tool") != "unit_details":
                    continue
                arguments = inspection.get("arguments") or {}
                target, sections = arguments.get("target"), arguments.get("sections")
                if not isinstance(target, str) or not isinstance(sections, list):
                    continue
                selected = unit_sections.setdefault(target, [])
                for section in sections:
                    if isinstance(section, str) and section not in selected:
                        selected.append(section)
            if len(unit_sections) >= MAX_PREPARED_UNIT_DETAILS:
                break
        queries = [
            ("unit_details", {"target": target, "sections": sections})
            for target, sections in list(unit_sections.items())[:MAX_PREPARED_UNIT_DETAILS]
            if sections
        ]
        construction_count = 0
        for city in view.get("cities", []):
            choice = city.get("constructionChoice") or {}
            names = choice.get("availableSinceChoice") or []
            target = city.get("handle")
            names = list(dict.fromkeys(name for name in names if isinstance(name, str)))[:4]
            if isinstance(target, str) and names:
                queries.append(("construction_details", {"target": target, "names": names}))
                construction_count += 1
            if construction_count >= MAX_PREPARED_CONSTRUCTION_DETAILS:
                break
        return queries
    
    
    async def prepare_startup(gateway, job, *, call_prefix: str = STARTUP_CALL_PREFIX) -> JsonObject:

    import asyncio

    class AdvisoryHost(StartupHost):
        def __init__(self):
            self.record = {"epoch": "g1", "gameTurn": 0}
            super().__init__(SimpleNamespace(service=SimpleNamespace(active_id="job", records={"job": self.record})))
            self.captures = []
            self.available = True
    
        async def tool(self, name, args):
            if name == "native_advice":
                self.captures.append(copy.deepcopy(args))
                return {
                    "epoch": args["epoch"],
                    "revision": args["revision"],
                    "turn": self.record["gameTurn"],
                    "available": self.available,
                    "recommendations": [
                        {
                            "id": f"native-{args['revision']}-{i}",
                            "category": "Construction",
                            "subject": "city1",
                            "explanation": "Original native explanation",
                            "command": {
                                "tool": "player_command",
                                "arguments": {"kind": "QUEUE_CONSTRUCTION", "target": "city1", "selection": name},
                            },
                            "costs": {"production": 40},
                            "prerequisites": ["Agriculture"],
                            "conflicts": ["city1"],
                        }
                        for i, name in enumerate(["Market", "Granary"] * 5)
                    ],
                    "limitations": ["No simulated discoveries."],
                }
            return await super().tool(name, args)
    
    
    class Classifier:
        def __init__(self, settings):
            self.settings, self.calls, self.mode = settings, [], "success"
    
        async def batch(self, evidence, *, timeout):
            self.calls.append(copy.deepcopy(evidence))
            if self.mode == "timeout":
                raise TimeoutError()
            if self.mode == "malformed":
                return {"requestId": request_id(evidence), "answers": "not an answer list"}
            body = request_body(evidence, self.settings)
            answers = []
            values = {"retrieval": "high", "preservation": "consider", "beliefs": "reconsider", "early_review": "review"}
            for q in body["questions"]:
                prefix = q["name"].split(":")[0]
                answer = {
                    "type": "choice",
                    "name": q["name"],
                    "choice": values.get(prefix, q["choices"][0]["value"]),
                    "confidence": 0.99,
                }
                if self.mode == "low":
                    answer["confidence"] = 0.1
                elif self.mode == "refusal":
                    answer = {"name": q["name"], "type": "refusal"}
                elif self.mode == "unknown":
                    answer["choice"] = "invented-choice"
                answers.append(answer)
            return {"answers": answers, "requestId": request_id(evidence), "usage": {"input_tokens": 100}}
    
    
    @asynccontextmanager
    async def setup(tmp_path, *, native_enabled=True, **options):
        settings = DecisionsSettings(decisions_enabled=True, **options)
        memory = CivilizationState(tmp_path / "memory", "Rome", settings.memory_context_chars)
        io = ServiceIO()
        gateway = ProposalGateway(memory, io, tmp_path / "workspace")
        gateway.native_advice_enabled = native_enabled
        classifier = Classifier(settings)
        gateway.advisories = AdvisoryRuntime(gateway, classifier, settings)
        host = AdvisoryHost()
        memory.bind("g1")
        try:
            yield memory, gateway, host, classifier
        finally:
            await io.close()
            memory.engine.dispose()

    class EntityDetails(BoundaryModel):
        target: Annotated[str, Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)]
    
    
    class UnitDetails(EntityDetails):
        sections: Annotated[list[UnitSection], Field(min_length=1, max_length=10)] = Field(default_factory=lambda: ["all"])
    
        @field_validator("sections")
        @classmethod
        def canonical_sections(cls, value):
            return ["all"] if "all" in value else sorted(set(value))

    internal fun captureNativeAdvice(player: Civilization, turn: PlayerTurnSnapshot, state: TurnSessionState, deadlineNanos: Long = Long.MAX_VALUE): NativeAdviceInputs {
        fun checkDeadline() {
            if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) throw InterruptedException()
            if (System.nanoTime() >= deadlineNanos) throw TimeoutException()
        }
        checkDeadline()
        val commands = linkedMapOf<Native.Action, NativeRecommendation>()
        val limits = linkedSetOf(
            "Diplomatic actions, declarations, peace and trades remain entirely player decisions.",
            "Air missions, religious/great-person abilities, road networks, multi-step worker plans and strategic enemy-city routing are not selected.",
            "Promotion entries are alternatives from the native selection pool; no live random draw is consumed.",
            "Combat recommendations apply native target values across legal damage bounds; overlapping ranges remain alternatives. Hidden turn/location damage rolls are never consulted. Risky, city and specialized attack branches may be unavailable.",
        )
        val observedTiles = turn.map.tiles.associateBy { it.position }
        val visibleHostiles = turn.map.tiles.filter { it.visible && it.units.any { unit -> unit.military && unit.atWar } }
        fun terrainDefinitions(tile: ObservedTile): List<com.unciv.models.ruleset.tile.Terrain>? {
            val base = tile.terrain ?: return null
            return (listOfNotNull(base, tile.naturalWonder) + tile.features.orEmpty()).map { name ->
                player.gameInfo.ruleset.terrains[name] ?: return null
            }
        }
        fun terrainDamage(tile: ObservedTile): Int? = terrainDefinitions(tile)?.sumOf { it.damagePerTurn }
        fun terrainHeight(tile: ObservedTile): Int? = terrainDefinitions(tile)?.let { terrains ->
            val elevation = terrains.flatMap { it.getMatchingUniques(UniqueType.VisibilityElevation).toList() }.sumOf { it.params[0].toInt() }
            elevation + if (terrains.any { it.hasUnique(UniqueType.BlocksLineOfSightAtSameElevation) }) 1 else 0
        }

            checkDeadline()

            selection?.let { args["selection"] = it }
            destination?.let { args["destination"] = obj("x" to it.x, "y" to it.y) }

        override fun cities(): OwnedCitiesSnapshot = playerOperation {
            runtime.accessGame { game ->
                val player = game.findAvailablePlayer(civilizationId)
                    ?: throw PlayerSessionException(PlayerSessionFailure.PLAYER_UNAVAILABLE)
                val state = state()
                val previousHandles = state.cityHandles.size
                val cities = player.cities
                    .asSequence()
                    .filter { city -> city.civ === player }
                    .map { city ->
                        OwnedCitySummary(
                            handle = state.cityHandle(city.id),
                            name = city.name,
                        )
                    }
                    .toList()
    
                if (previousHandles != state.cityHandles.size) runtime.commitCheckpoint()
    
                OwnedCitiesSnapshot(
                    epoch = runtime.epoch,
                    cities = Collections.unmodifiableList(cities),
                )
            }
        }
    
        override fun freeGreatPersonChoice(): FreeGreatPersonSnapshot = playerOperation {
            runtime.accessGame { game ->
                val player = game.findAvailablePlayer(civilizationId)
                    ?: throw PlayerSessionException(PlayerSessionFailure.PLAYER_UNAVAILABLE)
                val sharedDecision = synchronizeFreeGreatPersonDecision(game, player)
                val decision = if (sharedDecision == null) {
                    null
                } else {
                    val fingerprint = sharedDecision.fingerprint
                    FreeGreatPersonDecision(
                        handle = sharedDecision.handle,
                        remainingChoices = fingerprint.remainingChoices,
                        mayaLimited = fingerprint.mayaLimitedChoices > 0,
                        options = Collections.unmodifiableList(ArrayList(fingerprint.options)),
                    )
                }
    
                FreeGreatPersonSnapshot(
                    epoch = runtime.epoch,
                    decision = decision,
                )
            }
        }
    
        private fun synchronizeFreeGreatPersonDecision(
            game: GameInfo,
            player: Civilization,
        ): SharedFreeGreatPersonDecision? {
            val greatPeople = player.greatPeople
            val fingerprint = if (greatPeople.freeGreatPeople <= 0) {
                null
            } else {
                val options = greatPeople.getFreeGreatPersonOptions()
                    .map { unit -> unit.name }
                    .sorted()
                FreeGreatPersonFingerprint(
                    remainingChoices = greatPeople.freeGreatPeople,
                    mayaLimitedChoices = greatPeople.mayaLimitedFreeGP,
                    options = options,
                    turn = game.turns,
                    isYourTurn = game.isCurrentPlayer(player),
                )
            }
            val state = state()
            val previous = state.freeGreatPersonDecision
            return state.synchronizeFreeGreatPersonDecision(fingerprint).also {
                if (it != previous) runtime.commitCheckpoint()
            }
        }
    }
    
    private fun GameInfo.findAvailablePlayer(civilizationId: String): Civilization? = civilizations.singleOrNull { civilization ->
        civilization.civID == civilizationId &&
            civilization.isHuman() &&
            civilization.isMajorCiv()
    }
    
    private fun GameInfo.isCurrentPlayer(player: Civilization): Boolean = currentPlayer == player.civID && currentPlayerCiv === player
    
    private inline fun <T> playerOperation(operation: () -> T): T = try {
        operation()
    } catch (failure: PlayerSessionException) {
        throw failure
    } catch (_: RuntimeClosedException) {
        throw PlayerSessionException(PlayerSessionFailure.SESSION_CLOSED)
    } catch (_: RuntimeHaltedException) {
        throw PlayerSessionException(PlayerSessionFailure.GAME_HALTED)
    } catch (_: RuntimePausedException) {
        throw PlayerSessionException(PlayerSessionFailure.GAME_PAUSED)
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        throw PlayerSessionException(PlayerSessionFailure.QUERY_FAILED)
    }

    /** City-screen citizen controls and building sales, revalidated under the game monitor.
     * Queries never reassign citizens or refresh statistics. UI callers must also respect
     * their local input-disabled state. A shared tile changes working city, not ownership.
     */
    class PlayerCityManagementOperations(private val civ: Civilization, private val spectatorMode: Boolean = false) {
        data class Action(val available: Boolean, val unavailableReasons: List<String>)
        data class SpecialistOption(val name: String, val assigned: Int, val slots: Int, val assign: Action, val unassign: Action)
        data class SaleOption(
            val name: String, val gold: Int, val maintenance: Int, val description: String,
            val action: Action, val confirmation: String,
        )
    
        @Readonly
        private fun owns(city: City): Boolean = !spectatorMode && !civ.isSpectator() &&
            civ.gameInfo.civilizations.any { it === civ } && city.civ === civ && civ.cities.any { it === city }
    
        @Readonly
        private fun reasons(city: City): List<String> {
            if (!owns(city)) return listOf("This city is not controlled by the player")
            @LocalState val result = ArrayList<String>()
            if (!PlayerOperations(civ, spectatorMode).canAct()) result.add("This player cannot act now")
            if (city.isPuppet) result.add("Cannot manage citizens or sell buildings in a puppet city")
            return result
        }
    
        @Readonly fun control(city: City): Action = action(reasons(city))
    
        @Readonly
        fun focuses(city: City): List<CityFocus> = if (!owns(city)) emptyList() else frozen(CityFocus.entries.filter {
            it.tableEnabled && (it != CityFocus.FaithFocus || civ.gameInfo.isReligionEnabled())
        })
    
        fun trySetFocus(city: City, focus: CityFocus): Boolean = synchronized(civ.gameInfo) {
            if (!control(city).available || focus !in focuses(city)) return@synchronized false
            city.setCityFocus(focus)
            city.reassignPopulation()
            civ.updateStatsForNextTurn()
            true
        }
    
        fun trySetAvoidGrowth(city: City, enabled: Boolean): Boolean = synchronized(civ.gameInfo) {
            if (!control(city).available) return@synchronized false
            city.avoidGrowth = enabled
            city.reassignPopulation()
            civ.updateStatsForNextTurn()
            true
        }
    
        fun trySetManualSpecialists(city: City, enabled: Boolean): Boolean = synchronized(civ.gameInfo) {
            if (!specialistControl(city).available) return@synchronized false
            city.manualSpecialists = enabled
            if (!enabled) city.reassignPopulation()
            civ.updateStatsForNextTurn()
            true
        }
    
        /** The city screen only displays its specialist controls when slots exist. */
        @Readonly
        fun specialistControl(city: City): Action {
            @LocalState val result = reasons(city).toMutableList()
            if (owns(city) && city.population.getMaxSpecialists().isEmpty())
                result.add("This city has no specialist slots")
            return action(result)
        }
    
        /** Reset Citizens clears tile locks; other callers may request ordinary reassignment. */
        fun tryReassignPopulation(city: City, resetLocked: Boolean): Boolean = synchronized(civ.gameInfo) {
            if (!control(city).available) return@synchronized false
            city.reassignPopulation(resetLocked)
            civ.updateStatsForNextTurn()
            true
        }
    
        @Readonly
        private fun specialistReasons(city: City, name: String, assign: Boolean): List<String> {
            @LocalState val result = reasons(city).toMutableList()
            if (!owns(city)) return result
            val slots = city.population.getMaxSpecialists()[name]
            if (name !in civ.gameInfo.ruleset.specialists || slots <= 0) result.add("No slots for this specialist")
            if (assign) {
                if (city.population.getNewSpecialists()[name] >= slots) result.add("All specialist slots are occupied")
                if (city.population.getFreePopulation() <= 0) result.add("Unassign a citizen first")
            } else if (city.population.getNewSpecialists()[name] <= 0) result.add("No assigned specialist to remove")
            return result
        }
    
        @Readonly
        fun specialists(city: City): List<SpecialistOption> {
            if (!owns(city)) return emptyList()
            return frozen(city.population.getMaxSpecialists().entries.filter { it.key in civ.gameInfo.ruleset.specialists }
                .sortedBy { it.key }.map { (name, slots) ->
                    SpecialistOption(name, city.population.getNewSpecialists()[name], slots,
                        action(specialistReasons(city, name, true)), action(specialistReasons(city, name, false)))
                })
        }

    /**
     * Fixed-population comparison of a building's ongoing city yields. Each instance is
     * a batch for one game state; discard it when that state changes. The original game
     * is never edited, even temporarily. A private game copy owns all preview tiles,
     * cities, caches and statistics, so city initialization cannot steal live tiles.
     *
     * Both sides use the selected perpetual construction (Nothing by default).
     * Citizen assignments stay fixed. This
     * installs the building's passive effects only: completion triggers (free buildings,
     * units, technologies, population, etc.) are not executed. Other cities are refreshed
     * for global happiness and connection effects. Local and owned-empire yields are
     * returned separately; empire totals include native civilization-level modifiers.
     */
    class BuildingYieldPreview(private val source: GameInfo) {
        data class Yields(
            val total: Stats,
            val sources: Map<String, Stats>,
            val buildingMaintenance: Float,
            val foodPerTurn: Int,
            val turnsToGrowth: Int?,
            val turnsToStarvation: Int?,
            /** Native construction valuation deliberately ignores food growth penalties. */
            val automationTotal: Stats,
        )
    
        data class EmpireYields(val total: Stats, val happiness: Int, val cities: Map<String, Yields>)
    
        data class Comparison(val before: Yields, val after: Yields,
                              val empireBefore: EmpireYields, val empireAfter: EmpireYields)
    
        private val game by lazy { source.copyForPreview() }
    
        private val results = HashMap<Triple<String, String, String>, Comparison>()
    
        fun compare(city: City, building: Building, following: PerpetualConstruction = PerpetualConstruction.Idle): Comparison {
            require(city.civ.gameInfo === source && city in city.civ.cities)
            require(source.ruleset.buildings[building.name] === building)
            require(!city.cityConstructions.isBuilt(building.name))
            require(following.isBuildable(city.cityConstructions))
            return results.getOrPut(Triple(city.id, building.name, following.name)) {
                val owner = game.getCivilization(city.civ.civID)
                val target = owner.cities.single { it.id == city.id }
                val constructions = target.cityConstructions
                val queue = constructions.constructionQueue
                constructions.constructionQueue = arrayListOf(following.name)
                try {
                    refresh(owner)
                    val before = yields(target)
                    val empireBefore = empireYields(owner)
                    // setTransients rebuilds passive unique maps without executing
                    // addBuilding's completion triggers, free grants or map changes.
                    constructions.builtBuildings.add(building.name)
                    constructions.setTransients()
                    refresh(owner)
                    Comparison(before, yields(target), empireBefore, empireYields(owner))
                } finally {
                    constructions.builtBuildings.remove(building.name)
                    constructions.setTransients()
                    constructions.constructionQueue = queue
                    refresh(owner)
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun empireYields(civ: Civilization) = EmpireYields(
            civ.stats.statsForNextTurn.clone(), civ.stats.happiness,
            civ.cities.associate { it.id to yields(it) })
    
        private fun refresh(civ: Civilization) {
            civ.cache.updateCitiesConnectedToCapital(true)
            civ.cache.updateCivResources()
            for (city in civ.cities) {
                city.cityStats.updateTileStats()
                city.cityStats.updateCityHappiness(city.cityConstructions.getStats())
            }
            civ.stats.happiness = civ.stats.getHappinessBreakdown().values.sum().roundToInt()
            for (city in civ.cities)
                city.cityStats.update(updateTileStats = false, updateCivStats = false)
            civ.updateStatsForNextTurn()
        }
    
        private fun yields(city: City): Yields {
            val automation = CityStats(city)
            automation.statsFromTiles = city.cityStats.statsFromTiles.clone()
            automation.update(updateTileStats = false, updateCivStats = false, calculateGrowthModifiers = false)
            val sources = city.cityStats.finalStatList.mapValues { it.value.clone() }.toMutableMap()
            for ((name, amount) in city.cityStats.happinessList)
                sources.getOrPut(name) { Stats() }.happiness = amount
            val total = city.cityStats.currentCityStats.clone()
            total.happiness = city.cityStats.happinessList.values.sum()
            return Yields(total, sources, -(city.cityStats.finalStatList["Maintenance"]?.gold ?: 0f),
                city.foodForNextTurn(), city.population.getNumTurnsToNewPopulation(), city.population.getNumTurnsToStarvation(), automation.currentCityStats.clone())
        }
    }

ACKNOWLEDGE_ALERT uses target=an alert handle with canAcknowledge=true and full content already read from player_turn at this revision, including FirstContact; a revision from a command receipt alone is insufficient (OBSERVATION_REQUIRED). This dismisses only that message, including WarDeclaration. DISMISS_NOTIFICATIONS takes targets=[notice handles] with canDismiss=true from a fresh player_turn; the whole batch is validated before clearing any messages. It clears the player API pending list, preserves native notification history, and returns the exact dismissedNotifications in the receipt. DECLARE_WAR uses target=known civilizationId and requires confirmWar=true after reading declarationConfirmation at this revision. RESPOND_FRIENDSHIP uses an alert target and selection=Accept or Decline after reading its friendship content and choices. Bilateral trades and friendship proposals use the communication trade tools. Shared human/agent negotiations pause gameplay until they close; native AI offers remain pending without pausing gameplay. Successful requests replay; restart recovery requires durableRecovery. Re-observe after commands. END_TURN requires reviewId=turnReview.id from a fresh player_turn and either canEndTurn=true or explicit deferChoices=true when turnControls.canDeferChoices is offered. Idle units do not block END_TURN; deferReason is optional audit context. Any mutation invalidates the review. TURN_REVIEW_REQUIRED means read the current review and use its reviewId. ATTACK uses an owned unit target and the exact offered destination and attackFrom; CITY_ATTACK uses an owned city and offered destination; omit attackFrom (only ATTACK accepts it). Read receipt.combat: discovery can stop movement before an attack. SET_UNIT_ORDER and PROMOTE_UNIT use an owned unit and selection=available option name. RESOLVE_CAPTURED_CITY uses the capture alert handle (including civilian return and traded-city KeepCity/Liberate choices) and selection=available option name after reading the full decision at this revision. MANAGE_CAPTURED_CITY uses an owned city and available captureOptions selection. BUY_CONSTRUCTION uses city target and purchases.constructions selection=name; BUY_TILE uses city target and purchases.tiles destination (no selection). UPGRADE_UNIT uses unit target and economy.upgrades selection=targetName. PILLAGE and DISBAND_UNIT use unit target without selection. Re-read player_turn before these economic commands; read costs and any confirmation text, and set confirmAction=true when confirmation is present. Read receipt.economy for actual gold and unit changes; re-observe afterward. City management commands require a fresh player_turn at this revision. SET_CITY_FOCUS uses city target and management.focusOptions selection=name. SET_AVOID_GROWTH and SET_MANUAL_SPECIALISTS use city target and enabled boolean. ASSIGN_SPECIALIST / UNASSIGN_SPECIALIST use city target and management.specialists selection=name; each changes one citizen. Assignment needs a free citizen: unwork a tile first if necessary. RESET_CITIZENS uses city target and clears tile locks before automatic allocation. SELL_BUILDING uses city target and management.buildingSales selection=name; read the refund, reasons and confirmation, then set confirmAction=true. REASSIGN_CITY_TILE uses receiving city target and an available management.sharedTiles destination; it needs a free citizen and releases the donor city's tile lock. Read receipt.cityManagement for actual allocations, yields, removed buildings and gold changes. ACTIVATE_GREAT_PERSON uses an owned unit target and selection=an available greatPerson.abilities name from a fresh player_turn. Abilities act at the current tile: move first if needed. Read effects and consumesUnit before acting, then read receipt.greatPerson and any new alerts or choices. RESPOND_CITY_STATE_ALERT uses an owned alert target and an available nativeDiplomacy.options name as selection; read its responseCommand in player_turn. CITY_STATE_ACTION uses a known diplomacy.cityStates civilizationId target and available actions.name selection; set confirmAction=true when its confirmation is nonempty. DECLARE_WAR also accepts known city-states. GIFT_UNIT uses an owned unit target with gift.action.available=true. ACTIVATE_GREAT_PERSON also supports native trade missions. Inspect receipt.cityState for actual influence, alliance, quest and unit changes. For distant movement read movement_preview(target,destination), then SET_UNIT_DESTINATION with the same choices. The native order resumes at the start of your turns. Inspect unit.movementOrder; CANCEL_UNIT_MOVEMENT stops it. For Work Boats read unit.waterImprovement, then CREATE_WATER_IMPROVEMENT with the unit target and selection=its offered name; the unit is consumed. Inspect receipt.movement and receipt.waterImprovement for actual effects. ADD_SPACESHIP_PART uses an owned unit target with spaceshipAssembly.available=true; it consumes that part in your capital. victory.ballot supplies world leader candidates: CAST_DIPLOMATIC_VOTE uses selection=civilizationId; ABSTAIN_DIPLOMATIC_VOTE has no target or selection.     class NativeAdviceIntegrationTest {
        @Test fun `native advice is scoped read only revision bound and refreshable`() {
            val root = Files.createTempDirectory("native-advice-")
            try {
                val log = root.resolve("probe.log")
                val process = ProcessBuilder(
                    Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", "java").toString(),
                    "-Xmx1g",
                    "-Djava.awt.headless=true",
                    "-Duncivai.assetsDir=${System.getProperty("uncivai.assetsDir")}",
                    "-cp",
                    System.getProperty("uncivai.testClasspath"),
                    "uncivai.NativeAdviceProbe",
                    root.toString(),
                ).redirectErrorStream(true).redirectOutput(log.toFile()).start()
                try {
                    check(process.waitFor(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) { Files.readString(log) }
                    assertEquals(Files.readString(log), 0, process.exitValue())
                } finally {
                    if (process.isAlive) process.destroyForcibly().waitFor(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                }
            } finally {
                deleteTreeWithoutFollowingLinks(root)
            }
        }

    package uncivai.player
    
    import com.unciv.logic.GameInfo
    import com.unciv.logic.civilization.Civilization
    import uncivai.GameExecutor
    import uncivai.HeadlessRuntime
    import uncivai.PlayerApiAccounting
    import uncivai.RuntimeClosedException
    import uncivai.RuntimeHaltedException
    import uncivai.RuntimePausedException
    import java.util.Collections
    
    /** Trusted host surface that assigns a fixed player identity to each session. */
    class PlayerHost(private val runtime: GameExecutor) {
        constructor(runtime: HeadlessRuntime) : this(runtime.executor)
    
        fun bindPlayer(civilizationId: String): PlayerSession = playerOperation {
            runtime.accessGame { game ->
                game.findAvailablePlayer(civilizationId)
                    ?: throw PlayerSessionException(PlayerSessionFailure.PLAYER_UNAVAILABLE)
            }
            BoundPlayerSession(runtime, civilizationId)
        }
    }
    
    interface PlayerSession {
        fun communicationChanges(): kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow<Long> = throw PlayerSessionException(PlayerSessionFailure.COMMAND_UNAVAILABLE)
        fun communication(request: kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject): kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject = throw PlayerSessionException(PlayerSessionFailure.COMMAND_UNAVAILABLE)
        fun capabilities(): PlayerCapabilities
    
        fun turn(): PlayerTurnSnapshot
    
        fun nativeAdvice(request: NativeAdviceRequest): NativeAdvice = NativeAdvice(request.epoch, null, request.revision, false, limitations = listOf("Native guidance unavailable on this session."))
    
        fun result(): PlayerFinalState
    
        fun missionPreview(request: MissionPreviewRequest): MissionPreview
    
        fun movementPreview(request: MovementPreviewRequest): MovementPreview
    
        fun inspect(request: PlayerInspectionRequest): PlayerInspection
    
        fun researchDetails(names: List<String> = emptyList()): ResearchDetails
    
        fun policyDetails(names: List<String> = emptyList()): PolicyDetails
    
        fun victoryProgress(request: VictoryProgressRequest = VictoryProgressRequest()): VictoryProgress
    
        /** Read a receipt only when every field matches this player's completed request. */
        fun completedReceipt(request: TurnCommandRequest): TurnCommandReceipt?
    
        fun execute(request: TurnCommandRequest): TurnCommandReceipt
    
        fun summary(): PlayerSummary
    
        fun cities(): OwnedCitiesSnapshot
    
        fun freeGreatPersonChoice(): FreeGreatPersonSnapshot
    }
    
    private class BoundPlayerSession(
        private val runtime: GameExecutor,
        private val civilizationId: String,
    ) : PlayerSession,
        PlayerApiAccounting {
        private val turnSession = TurnSession(runtime, civilizationId)
    
        override fun beginApiCall(tool: String, arguments: kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject?) = playerOperation { runtime.telemetry.startCall(civilizationId, tool, arguments) }
        override fun finishApiCall(id: String, outcome: String) = runtime.telemetry.finishCall(id, outcome)
    
        override fun communicationChanges() = playerOperation {
            runtime.accessGame { runtime.communicationChanges.forPlayer(civilizationId) }
        }
    
        override fun communication(request: kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject) = playerOperation {
            runtime.communication.handle(civilizationId, request)
        }
    
        override fun capabilities() = playerOperation {
            runtime.accessGame {
                PlayerCapabilities(durableRecovery = runtime.durableRecovery)
            }
        }
    
        override fun turn() = playerOperation { turnSession.snapshot() }
    
        override fun nativeAdvice(request: NativeAdviceRequest) = playerOperation { turnSession.nativeAdvice(request) }
    
        override fun result() = playerOperation { turnSession.snapshot().finalState(civilizationId) }
    
        override fun movementPreview(request: MovementPreviewRequest) = playerOperation { turnSession.movementPreview(request) }
    
        override fun inspect(request: PlayerInspectionRequest) = playerOperation { turnSession.inspect(request) }
    
        override fun missionPreview(request: MissionPreviewRequest) = playerOperation { turnSession.missionPreview(request) }
    
        override fun researchDetails(names: List<String>) = playerOperation { turnSession.researchDetails(names) }
    
        override fun policyDetails(names: List<String>) = playerOperation { turnSession.policyDetails(names) }
    
        override fun victoryProgress(request: VictoryProgressRequest) = playerOperation { turnSession.victoryProgress(request) }
    
        override fun completedReceipt(request: TurnCommandRequest) = playerOperation { turnSession.completedReceipt(request) }
    
        override fun execute(request: TurnCommandRequest) = playerOperation { turnSession.execute(request) }
    
        private fun state(): TurnSessionState = runtime.turnSessions.getOrPut(civilizationId) { TurnSessionState() }
    
        override fun summary(): PlayerSummary = playerOperation {
            runtime.accessGame { game ->
                request.arguments.requireNoArguments()
                PlayerTurnJson.json.encodeToString(PlayerFinalState.serializer(), session.result())
            }
        }

Arrival estimates can change as terrain and units become visible. afterMove.captureRisk identifies visible enemies that could capture an unguarded civilian at that stop. If the first stop has captureRisk, SET_UNIT_DESTINATION requires explicit confirmAction=true. Later route turns recheck danger and stop for a new decision; confirmation is not persistent.     import com.networknt.schema.InputFormat
    import com.networknt.schema.SchemaRegistry
    import com.networknt.schema.SpecificationVersion
    import kotlinx.serialization.DeserializationStrategy
    import kotlinx.serialization.SerializationException
    import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

    /** Only bundled schemas are compiled. Callers provide data, never schemas or reference locations. */
    internal class InputSchema(name: String) {
        val document = Json.parseToJsonElement(
            checkNotNull(javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/uncivai/schemas/$name.json")) { "Missing schema: $name" }
                .bufferedReader().use { it.readText() },
        ).jsonObject
        private val validator = SchemaRegistry.withDefaultDialect(SpecificationVersion.DRAFT_2020_12)
            .getSchema(document.toString(), InputFormat.JSON).also { it.initializeValidators() }
    
        fun validate(arguments: JsonObject): JsonObject {
            if (validator.validate(arguments.toString(), InputFormat.JSON).isNotEmpty()) invalid()
            return arguments
        }
    
        fun <T> decode(serializer: DeserializationStrategy<T>, arguments: JsonObject): T {
            validate(arguments)
            return try {
                Json.decodeFromJsonElement(serializer, arguments)
            } catch (_: SerializationException) {
                invalid()
            } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) {
                invalid()
            }
        }
    
        private fun invalid(): Nothing = throw PlayerSessionException(PlayerSessionFailure.INVALID_ARGUMENT)
    }
    
    internal object InputSchemas {
        val communication = InputSchema("communication")
        val turnCommand = InputSchema("turn-command")
        val details = InputSchema("details")

        val movementPreview = InputSchema("movement-preview")
        val playerInspect = InputSchema("player-inspect")
        val missionPreview = InputSchema("mission-preview")
        val empty = InputSchema("empty")
    }

    def project_entity(entity: JsonObject, tool: str, sections: list[str]) -> JsonObject:
        if "all" in sections:
            result = copy.deepcopy(entity)
            if tool == "city_details":
                city_construction_data(result)
                if result.get("constructionEstimates"):
                    result["constructionEstimateBasis"] = ESTIMATE_BASIS
            return result
        fields = UNIT_FIELDS if tool == "unit_details" else CITY_FIELDS
        paths = list(UNIT_IDENTITY if tool == "unit_details" else CITY_IDENTITY)
        paths.extend(path for section in sections for path in fields[section])
        projected: JsonObject = {}
        for path in paths:
            source, target = entity, projected
            parts = path.split(".")
            for key in parts[:-1]:
                if not isinstance(source.get(key), dict):
                    break
                source = source[key]
                target = target.setdefault(key, {})
            else:
                if parts[-1] in source:
                    target[parts[-1]] = copy.deepcopy(source[parts[-1]])
        if tool == "city_details" and "constructionEstimates" in projected:
            projected["constructionEstimates"] = {
                name: estimate
                for name, estimate in projected["constructionEstimates"].items()
                if name in entity.get("constructionQueue", [])
            }
            projected["constructionEstimateBasis"] = ESTIMATE_BASIS
        if tool == "city_details":
            city_construction_data(projected)
        return projected

            if meta.get("format") != memory.FORMAT_VERSION:
                return {"status": "unavailable", "reason": "unsupported_memory_format"}
            records = [
                {"category": row["category"], "body": json.loads(row["body"])}
                for row in db.execute(
                    select(memory.records)
                    .select_from(memory.current_records)
                    .where(memory.records.c.category.in_({"guidance", "routing", "delivery"}))
                    .order_by(memory.record_order)
                ).mappings()
            ]
            exposures = [r["body"] for r in records if r["category"] == "guidance" and r["body"]["type"] == "exposure"]
            latest = exposures[-1] if exposures else None
            advice = (
                {
                    "status": "available" if latest["available"] else "unavailable",
                    "epoch": latest["epoch"],
                    "revision": latest.get("revision"),
                    "recommendationsExposed": len(latest["recommendations"]),
                    "source": latest.get("source", "native"),
                    "unavailableReasons": latest.get("limitations", []) if not latest["available"] else [],
                }
                if latest
                else {"status": "waiting_for_first_observation"}
            )
            drafts = [r["body"] for r in records if r["category"] == "delivery"]
            outstanding = [d for d in drafts if d["status"] in {"classifying", "queued", "sending", "omitted"}]
            waiting = [d for d in outstanding if d["status"] != "omitted"]
            states = meta.get("routing:events", {})
            incoming = [s for s in states.values() if not s.get("attempted") and not s.get("completed")]

    @Serializable
    data class PlayerInspectionRequest(
        val subject: InspectionSubject,
        val target: String? = null,
        val destination: TilePosition? = null,
        val category: String? = null,
        val names: List<String> = emptyList(),
        val search: String? = null,
        val turn: Int? = null,
        val offset: Int = 0,
        val limit: Int = 50,
    )
    
    @Serializable
    data class PlayerInspection(val epoch: String, val revision: String, val turn: Int, val subject: InspectionSubject, val data: JsonObject)
    
    internal fun inspectPlayer(player: Civilization, state: TurnSessionState, turn: PlayerTurnSnapshot, request: PlayerInspectionRequest): JsonObject {
        val subject = request.subject
        if (request.offset < 0 || request.limit !in 1..100 || request.names.size > 16 || request.names.any { it.isBlank() } ||
            request.search?.length?.let { it > 128 } == true ||
            (request.target != null && subject !in setOf(InspectionSubject.UNIT, InspectionSubject.ROAD, InspectionSubject.TILE)) ||
            (request.destination != null && subject !in setOf(InspectionSubject.UNIT, InspectionSubject.ROAD, InspectionSubject.TILE)) ||
            ((request.category != null || request.names.isNotEmpty() || request.search != null) && subject != InspectionSubject.CIVILOPEDIA) ||
            (request.turn != null && subject !in setOf(InspectionSubject.REPLAY, InspectionSubject.NOTIFICATIONS)) ||
            request.turn?.let { it !in 0..player.gameInfo.turns } == true
        ) {
            inspectionFailure(PlayerSessionFailure.INVALID_ARGUMENT)
        }
        fun tile(): Tile = request.destination?.let { player.gameInfo.tileMap.getOrNull(it.x, it.y) }
            ?.takeIf { it.isExplored(player) } ?: inspectionFailure(PlayerSessionFailure.OPTION_UNAVAILABLE)
        return when (subject) {
            InspectionSubject.POLITICS -> inspectPolitics(player, request)
    
            InspectionSubject.WONDERS -> inspectWonders(player, request)
    
            InspectionSubject.NOTIFICATIONS -> inspectNotifications(player, request)
    
            InspectionSubject.REPLAY -> inspectReplay(player, request)
    
            InspectionSubject.CIVILOPEDIA -> inspectCivilopedia(player, request)
    
            InspectionSubject.TILE -> inspectTile(player, tile(), request.target, state)
    
            InspectionSubject.UNIT -> {
                if ((request.target == null) == (request.destination == null)) inspectionFailure(PlayerSessionFailure.INVALID_ARGUMENT)
                val units = if (request.target != null) {
                    listOf(inspectionUnit(player, state, request.target))
                } else {
                    tile().takeIf { it.isVisible(player) }?.getUnits()?.filter { it.isVisibleTo(player) }?.toList()
                        ?: inspectionFailure(PlayerSessionFailure.OPTION_UNAVAILABLE)
                }
                obj("units" to units.map { inspectUnit(player, it) })
            }
    
            InspectionSubject.ROAD -> inspectRoad(
                player,
                inspectionUnit(player, state, request.target),
                tile(),
                canStart = turn.map.units.single { it.handle == request.target }.controls?.canConnectRoad == true,
            )
        }
    }
    
    internal fun inspectionUnit(player: Civilization, state: TurnSessionState, target: String?): MapUnit = player.units.getCivUnits().singleOrNull { state.unitHandles[it.id] == target && !it.isDestroyed }
        ?: inspectionFailure(PlayerSessionFailure.UNIT_UNAVAILABLE)
    
    internal fun inspectionFailure(failure: PlayerSessionFailure): Nothing = throw PlayerSessionException(failure)

        "items" to rows.drop(request.offset).take(request.limit),
        "total" to rows.size,
        "nextOffset" to (request.offset + request.limit).takeIf { it < rows.size },
    )
    
    internal fun HexCoord.inspectionPosition() = obj("x" to x, "y" to y)
    internal fun Stats.inspectionStats() = JsonObject(map { (stat, value) -> stat.name to JsonPrimitive(value) }.toMap())

    import com.unciv.models.ruleset.PerpetualConstruction
    
    /** A detached world for read-only estimates that need native cache recalculation.
     * Empty queues must not choose production while setting up a preview. City tile
     * sets are serialization collections that GameInfo.clone otherwise shares.
     */
    fun GameInfo.copyForPreview(): GameInfo = clone().also { copy ->
        copy.gameParameters = gameParameters.clone()
        copy.gameParameters.godMode = gameParameters.godMode
        copy.tileMap.mapParameters = tileMap.mapParameters.clone()
        for (civ in copy.civilizations) for (city in civ.cities) {
            city.tiles = HashSet(city.tiles)
            city.workedTiles = HashSet(city.workedTiles)
            city.lockedTiles = HashSet(city.lockedTiles)
            if (city.cityConstructions.constructionQueue.isEmpty())
                city.cityConstructions.constructionQueue.add(PerpetualConstruction.Idle.name)
        }
        if (copy.currentPlayer.isEmpty()) copy.currentPlayer = copy.civilizations.first().civID
        copy.setTransients(ruleset)
    }
    def fingerprint(value):
        return hashlib.sha256(canonical(value).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    
    def estimate_tokens(body):
        """One token per serialized UTF-8 byte, plus framing and per-question headroom."""
        return len(canonical(body).encode("utf-8")) + 2048 + 128 * len(body["questions"])
    
    
    class DecisionsLedger:
        def __init__(self, root):
            self.root = private_directory(Path(root))
            authority_file, self.path = self.root / "decisions-authority.json", self.root / "decisions.sqlite3"
            if authority_file.exists():
                regular_file(authority_file, private=True)
                self.authority = json.loads(authority_file.read_text())["authority"]
                pinned_authority = self.authority
                if not self.path.is_file():
                    raise ValueError("Decisions accounting ledger missing for the pinned authority")
            else:
                pinned_authority = None
                self.authority = secrets.token_hex(32)
            if self.path.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("Unsafe Decisions ledger path")
            self.engine = sqlite_engine(self.path, wal=True)
            with self.engine.begin() as db:
                metadata.create_all(db)
                recorded = db.scalar(select(authority_table.c.value).where(authority_table.c.key == "authority"))
                if recorded is None:
                    db.execute(insert(authority_table).values(key="authority", value=self.authority))
                elif pinned_authority is not None and recorded != pinned_authority:
                    raise ValueError("Decisions accounting authority does not match its ledger")
                else:
                    self.authority = recorded
            self.path.chmod(0o600)
            if authority_file.exists():
                regular_file(authority_file, private=True)
                if json.loads(authority_file.read_text())["authority"] != self.authority:
                    raise ValueError("Decisions accounting authority does not match its ledger")
            else:
                write_private_json(authority_file, {"authority": self.authority})

    package uncivai.player
    
    import com.unciv.logic.civilization.Civilization
    import com.unciv.logic.civilization.PlayerCityManagementOperations
    import com.unciv.logic.copyForPreview
    import uncivai.obj
    
    /** Native citizen allocation on detached worlds. Never try a focus on the live city. */
    internal fun inspectCityFocus(player: Civilization, state: TurnSessionState, turn: PlayerTurnSnapshot, target: String?): kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject {
        val city = player.cities.singleOrNull { state.cityHandles[it.id] == target }
            ?: inspectionFailure(PlayerSessionFailure.CITY_UNAVAILABLE)
        val observed = turn.cities.single { it.handle == target }
        val options = observed.management?.focusOptions.orEmpty().filter { it.action.available }
        val construction = city.cityConstructions.constructionQueue.firstOrNull()
        return obj(
            "city" to target,
            "name" to city.name,
            "available" to options.isNotEmpty(),
            "currentFocus" to city.getCityFocus().name,
            "options" to options.map { option ->
                // A fresh copy for each alternative preserves the same initial
                // locks, specialist assignments and neighbouring-city allocations.
                val game = player.gameInfo.copyForPreview()
                val owner = game.getCivilization(player.civID)
                val preview = owner.cities.single { it.id == city.id }
                val operations = PlayerCityManagementOperations(owner)
                val focus = operations.focuses(preview).single { it.name == option.name }
                check(operations.trySetFocus(preview, focus))
                val development = observeCityDevelopment(preview)
                obj(
                    "name" to option.name,
                    "label" to option.label,
                    "command" to obj("kind" to "SET_CITY_FOCUS", "target" to target, "selection" to option.name),
                    "yields" to development.yields.associate { it.stat to it.amount },
                    "foodPerTurn" to development.foodPerTurn,
                    "turnsToGrowth" to development.turnsToGrowth,
                    "turnsToStarvation" to development.turnsToStarvation,
                    "construction" to construction,
                    "constructionTurns" to construction?.let { constructionTurns(preview, it) },
                    "avoidGrowth" to development.avoidGrowth,
                    "manualSpecialists" to preview.manualSpecialists,
                    "workedTiles" to development.tiles.filter { it.worked }.map { obj("x" to it.position.x, "y" to it.position.y) },
                    "lockedTiles" to development.tiles.filter { it.locked }.map { obj("x" to it.position.x, "y" to it.position.y) },
                    "specialists" to preview.population.getNewSpecialists().toSortedMap(),
                )
            },
            "limitations" to listOf(
                "Each alternative applies the native focus operation independently at current population, preserving tile locks, growth settings and manual specialists.",
                "Construction estimates refer to the current queue head, excluding earlier or subsequent builds. No future population, improvements, enemy actions or combined construction/focus choice is simulated.",
                "Changing focus can reassign citizens even when its name matches the current focus. Keeping current assignments is a separate no-action choice.",
            ),
        )
    }

    class BoundaryModel(BaseModel):

    def _setting(value: str) -> str:

            raise ValueError("INVALID_SETTING")
        return value
